As part of our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE) practices across our projects, we are looking for an experienced Safety Officer who can establish, implement, and monitor robust safety systems while ensuring compliance with statutory regulations and company safety standards.

title: Robotics teacher
description:
**Job description**

As the Teacher Trainer at Pi Jam Foundation, you would be responsible for building the capacity of Instruction Specialists/ ICT Teachers and facilitating Pi Labs at partner government and affordable private schools to create a high\-quality computer science education ecosystem for student learning. This would include exhibiting excellent training skills, teaching, a well\-balanced, analytical and creative mindset to problem\-solve and provide innovative solutions, along with taking the initiative to own and build a part of Pi Jam reflective of their own core values that concur with the organizational vision and genuinely commits themselves to ensure that the value our program adds to a student’s life is sustainable, meaningful and greater than individual motivations.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

As a Teacher Trainer, you will be tasked with supporting all present and future Pi Jam Foundation educational initiatives and programs. Your portfolio will include:  
● Trainings and Capacity Building  
○ Builds teachers’ capacity through conducting various training sessions as per the program and on the job assistance during monitoring visits so that they best meet their teaching\-learning and school management responsibilities  
○ Collect, devise and share with schools, successful teaching methodologies that can be implemented in the classroom.  
○ Undertakes teachers’ training needs assessment, prepares training plans, develops training aid materials and conducts evaluation of training sessions  
○ Assists Program, Curriculum Development and Research team in developing training manuals.  
○ Participates in professional growth and development and stays abreast of current research through continuing education, educational seminars,workshops,conferences, membership in profession  
○ Participate in sessions during the beginning of the year training programme as per the schedule shared by the organisation.  
○ Participate in the monthly learning circles to share best practices with other teachers and prepare for the upcoming classes  
○ Work with the Program Manager to build teaching capacity as per their feedback

● Program Delivery  
○ Collects and compiles school and training data and assists the Program team in data analysis and interpretation and report development.  
○ Submits accurate and proper monitoring, supervision, training, observation, and other relevant reports to the Program Team in timely manner  
○ Support Program team in order to enhance the quality of basic education.  
○ Ensure Optimum instructional delivery of Curriculum across the specified grades in assigned school(s). This may involve teaching(\& travel) in classrooms spread across the city.  
○ Creation of monthly grade specific goals and daily lesson plans with the help of Program Manager in line with Pi Jam's curriculum and teaching philosophy.  
○ Assess and Monitor Student Learning Outcomes and accomplishments in a variety of ways(Assessments, Projects, Quiz, etc) on a regular basis and provide progress reports as required  
● Event  
○ Coordinate with school authorities / teachers and support them to conduct an annual showcase for the students in your school.  
○ Conduct hackathons, quizzes, field visits for students to increase interest and provide learning experiences.  
○ Support Pi Jam Team in basic operational and program/event requirements for the annual event(s).

Pay: ₹10,227\.04 \- ₹39,283\.75 per month

title: General Manager
description:
Job Summary

The General Manager – Hypermart is responsible for the overall business performance and operational management of the hypermarket. The role focuses on driving sales growth, maximizing profitability, ensuring operational excellence, delivering outstanding customer service, leading cross\-functional teams, and implementing business strategies to achieve organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities1\. Business \& Operations Management

* Lead and oversee all hypermarket operations.
* Develop and implement business strategies to achieve company objectives.
* Ensure efficient functioning of all departments.
* Monitor operational performance and improve productivity.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

2\. Sales \& Profitability

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Manage Profit \& Loss (P\&L) and maximize profitability.
* Analyze sales trends and implement growth strategies.
* Monitor expenses and control operational costs.
* Plan promotional campaigns and seasonal sales activities.

3\. Customer Experience

* Ensure high standards of customer service.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and resolve escalated complaints.
* Improve customer loyalty through excellent service and operational efficiency.

4\. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead and manage departmental heads and store management teams.
* Recruit, train, coach, and develop employees.
* Conduct performance reviews and succession planning.
* Build a positive, performance\-driven work culture.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and employee engagement.

5\. Inventory \& Supply Chain Management

* Maintain optimum inventory levels.
* Reduce stock loss, shrinkage, and wastage.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and logistics teams.
* Ensure timely stock replenishment and availability.

6\. Financial Management

* Prepare and manage annual operating budgets.
* Monitor financial performance and key business metrics.
* Improve return on investment (ROI) through cost optimization.
* Approve major operational expenditures.

7\. Compliance \& Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with statutory regulations and company policies.
* Maintain health, safety, and hygiene standards.
* Coordinate internal and external audits.
* Implement risk management and loss prevention measures.

8\. Reporting \& Strategic Planning

* Prepare business performance reports for senior management.
* Review KPIs and implement corrective actions.
* Identify market opportunities and expansion strategies.
* Collaborate with HR, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 5–15\+ years of experience in retail, supermarket, or hypermarket operations.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in a General Manager or senior leadership role.

Required Skills

* Strategic leadership
* Retail business management
* Profit \& Loss (P\&L) management
* Financial planning and budgeting
* Sales and business development
* Inventory and supply chain management
* Customer relationship management
* Team leadership and people development
* Negotiation and vendor management
* Data analysis and decision\-making
* MS Excel, ERP, POS systems, and MIS reporting
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Revenue and sales growth
* Gross profit and net profit
* EBITDA and operating margin
* Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Inventory turnover
* Shrinkage percentage
* Employee productivity and retention
* Audit and compliance score
* Budget adherence
* Overall store operational efficiency

Working Conditions

* Full\-time position with flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and extended hours as required.
* Frequent interaction with customers, vendors, and senior management.
* Responsible for managing large teams and multiple departments within the hypermarket.

This job description is suitable for a **General Manager** overseeing a large\-format hypermarket or retail chain, with full responsibility for business performance, operations, and organizational leadership.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

description:

------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

We’re looking for an exceptional Associate – Learning \& Development to help us institutionalize learning, build internal capabilities, and eventually power skill development across the Indian construction ecosystem. If you love designing structured training programs, collaborating across teams, and growing with purpose — this is your moment.

**Biltrax Learning \& Development Cell (LDC)Proposed Role: Associate – Learning \& Development**

**Objective**

To build a structured, high\-impact internal training ecosystem at Biltrax that strengthens team capabilities, embeds cross\-functional learning, and scales with the company's growth. The LDC Lead will anchor both internal and client\-facing learning programs, ensuring continuity, quality, and evolution of knowledge.

**Role Title**

* **Associate – Learning \& Development** (Official designation for hiring and internal alignment)

**Role Type**

* Will work closely with the HR team to align training with people development goals
* Full\-time role
* Reports to: Founder/CEO
* Based in: Navi Mumbai (preferred)
* Initial team size: Individual contributor, may expand with interns or content support as needed

**Responsibilities:**

**Program Management**

Plan and schedule weekly/monthly training for internal teams

**Curriculum Development**

Build role\-specific learning journeys (e.g., BD, Analyst, Strategy, Client Engagement); create structured coursework, modular curricula, and progression maps for different job functions, including assessments and certification paths

**Session Coordination**

Coordinate with internal/external trainers, manage logistics, prepare materials

**Content Creation**

Create or curate decks, training documents, SOPs, playbooks

**Feedback \& Iteration**

Conduct surveys, measure adoption, and refine sessions based on feedback

**Client Workshops**

Organize and support training sessions/certifications for clients; lead training for analyst and pre\-sales teams built specifically for client organizations; map client organizations to identify training needs and knowledge gaps for targeted capability\-building initiatives

**Certification \& Credentials**

Design and issue internal and client\-side certifications in collaboration with management; maintain record of professionals within client ecosystems and identify opportunities to train, upskill, and certify them

**Knowledge Repository**

Maintain an internal resource bank of learning material; keep a detailed and exhaustive record of all training sessions, certifications, attendees, outcomes, and follow\-ups for both internal and client\-side programs; maintain individual LDC history for each team member to support performance reviews and define long\-term career trajectories

**Profile Requirements**

* Possesses a scale\-oriented mindset with a positive, proactive, and forward\-looking approach; demonstrates the ability to institutionalize best practices with long\-term thinking

**Key Objectives**

* Ensure minimum learning benchmarks are met before assigning team members to client\-facing roles — similar to structured models followed by top consulting firms. Internal certifications may be mandatory for progression
* Institutionalize learning as a core pillar of Biltrax's culture, ensuring that upskilling becomes a continuous and structured process across all levels

This may include supporting sales teams with high quality insights, performance tracking, analytics, business lead generation, and growth initiatives.

Lead and steer the team to deliver coordinated execution across diverse markets and stakeholders, achieving broader Business Management and GTS objectives.

title: HR Generalist, Technical Recruiting
description:
**About the company**
---------------------


Kantiv is a technology company revolutionizing the way professionals in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry manage marketing and revenue operations. Our AI\-powered software streamlines workflows, making it easier for teams to collaborate, innovate, and succeed.


We're building a world\-class engineering organization to solve some of the most challenging AI and data problems in the industry. Hiring exceptional people is one of the biggest competitive advantages we have—and we're looking for someone who shares that belief.

**About the role**
------------------


We're looking for an HR Generalist with a strong background in technical recruiting to help us build and scale our engineering organization in India.


This is a recruiting\-first role. You'll partner directly with engineering leadership to identify, attract, and hire exceptional software engineers, AI engineers, product managers, and technical leaders who will shape the future of Kantiv.


Beyond recruiting, you'll help build the people foundation that enables our engineering team to do their best work—from onboarding and employee experience to HR operations and manager support.


We're looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional talent, building lasting relationships, and creating systems that scale as the company grows.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Technical Recruiting**

* Own full\-cycle recruiting for software engineering, AI/ML, product, platform, DevOps, QA, and other technical roles.
* Partner closely with engineering managers and leadership to understand hiring priorities, define ideal candidate profiles, and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Build proactive sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, GitHub, referrals, recruiting communities, and other creative channels.
* Screen candidates for technical capability, communication skills, growth potential, and cultural alignment.
* Coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first conversation through offer acceptance.
* Continuously improve hiring velocity, quality, and recruiting processes through data and experimentation.

### **People Operations**

* Manage onboarding to ensure every new hire has an exceptional first\-day experience.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and help create a high\-performance engineering culture.
* Partner with managers on performance conversations, employee development, and day\-to\-day people matters.
* Maintain HR documentation, employee records, and ensure compliance with Indian employment regulations.
* Help improve HR processes, policies, and operational workflows as the company scales.

### **Building the Engineering Organization**

* Partner with leadership to continuously raise the hiring bar.
* Develop structured interview processes, scorecards, and recruiting playbooks.
* Strengthen our employer brand within India's engineering community.
* Build long\-term talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
* Use recruiting metrics and hiring insights to improve decision\-making and forecast hiring capacity.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4–8 years of experience in HR with significant experience recruiting technical talent.
* A proven track record of successfully hiring software engineers and other technical professionals.
* Strong sourcing skills and the ability to identify exceptional candidates before they begin actively looking.
* Experience working closely with engineering leaders and understanding technical hiring requirements.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR best practices.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruiting platforms.

**Experience we'd be particularly excited about**
-------------------------------------------------

* Experience recruiting for AI, machine learning, backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, or data engineering roles.
* Experience working at a high\-growth startup or scaling engineering organizations.
* Experience building recruiting processes from the ground up.
* A strong network within India's engineering community.
* Experience using AI tools to improve recruiting efficiency, sourcing, scheduling, and candidate engagement.
* A passion for building high\-performing teams and exceptional candidate experiences.

**What to expect**
------------------


We conduct a rigorous interview process based on integrity, talent, and drive. We trust our teammates from day one and move quickly to evaluate your fit for the role. The entire interview process typically takes approximately two weeks.


Here's what to expect:

* 30\-minute introductory conversation to learn about your background and tell you more about Kantiv.
* 45\-minute recruiting case study focused on sourcing strategy and hiring execution for a technical role.
* 60\-minute deep dive into previous hiring successes, recruiting metrics, and people operations experience.
* 45\-minute interview with engineering leadership focused on technical recruiting, stakeholder management, and hiring philosophy.
* 30\-minute culture interview.

title: Sr Director - SC Manufacturing & Co-Man Ops
description:
Overview:

The Manufacturing lead provides strategic and operational leadership for PepsiCo India Foods’ manufacturing set\-up, covering existing company\-owned plants and the national Contract Manufacturing network.  

The role ensures safe, compliant, cost\-efficient, quality production meeting PEPSICO standards and all the local regulatory requirements while building technical and operational capabilities, co\-driving expansion, raising the bar on talent in manufacturing team, driving continuous improvement, productivity and sustainability initiatives in manufacturing operations, driving world class operating standards, co\-leading Front Line Experience and Employee relations agenda.


Responsibilities:
**A. Company\-Owned Plants**

**1\. Manufacturing Operations Leadership**

* Lead end\-to\-end operations across operational plants, delivering volume, service, efficiency, cost, productivity, quality, safety and people KPIs.
* Drive readiness, commissioning, and stabilization for new green\-field plant and brownfield expansions.
* Ensure execution of production schedules, capacity utilization, waste control, and True efficiency/ OEE improvement.

**2\. Quality, Food Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure 100% compliance with PepsiCo Quality Mandates, FSSAI standards, GMP, and regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen internal controls (GCS, AIB, statutory audits) and enable timely resolution of audit findings.

**3\. People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead Plant Managers, and Co\-man operations manager.
* Drive capability uplift (M\&W, digital tools, operational excellence) and talent development across plants.
* Foster a strong culture of safety, ownership, and frontline empowerment.

**4\. Cost \& Productivity Management**

* Deliver cost\-optimization initiatives (MUV reduction, energy efficiency, waste reduction, automation etc).
* Manage annual manufacturing budgets and ensure AOP/forecast adherence.

**5\. Capital Projects \& Infrastructure Expansion**

* Oversee execution of new manufacturing lines and ensure delivery on timelines, budgets, and performance outputs.
* Lead the full lifecycle of the ‘upcoming green field projects’—including site evaluation, layout approval, commissioning, trials, and ramp\-up.

**6\. Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with R\&D, Procurement, PPGA, HR, Legal and Finance to drive Business, Supply Chain and People agenda
* Effective collaboration with SC verticals viz Agro, Productivity \& Performance, Sustainability, Quality \& Foods Safety, EHS, SC Planning \& Logistics and Engineering to drive Business and SC priorities.
* Represent Manufacturing in Supply Chain and Cross functional forums.

**7\.** **People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Embed PepsiCo values and leadership behaviours across plant leadership teams, ensuring consistent culture, ethics, and ways of working across legacy and greenfield sites.
* Partner closely with HR to drive workforce planning, succession readiness, leadership pipeline development, and capability building for critical manufacturing roles.
* Champion a strong frontline engagement culture across permanent and contractual workforce, driving ownership, inclusion, and high\-performance behaviours.
* Support industrial relations stability by proactively shaping plant\-level leadership capability in people management, employee relations, and statutory compliance.

**8\. Sustainability**

* Drive PepsiCo’s sustainability agenda across company\-owned plants and Coman sites, with clear ownership for water stewardship, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and emssions intensity improvement.
* Lead deployment of sustainable manufacturing practices including zero waste to landfill, renewable energy adoption, water positivity initiatives, and resource circularity across the manufacturing network.
* Embed sustainability goals into plant and CoMan operating rhythms, capital investment decisions, and productivity programs to ensure cost, efficiency, and sustainability outcomes are jointly delivered.
* Partner with Sustainability, Engineering, HR, and Procurement to build frontline and leadership capability on sustainable operations and responsible manufacturing practices.
* Ensure sustainability standards, reporting, and compliance requirements are met across all sites, including third\-party manufacturers, aligned to PepsiCo global commitments and external audit expectations.
* Champion a culture of environmental ownership and accountability across plant leadership teams, driving measurable improvements through data, governance, and continuous improvement.

 **B. CoMan Network (Current Sites \+ Expansion Pipeline)**

**1\. CoMan Governance \& Performance Management**

* Lead operational oversight for all CoMan partners delivering 100K\+ annual volumes.
* Ensure compliance with PepsiCo quality and food safety and applicable statutory requirements.
* Drive consistency in performance through scorecards, KPIs, and regular business reviews.

**2\. Capability Building \& Operational Excellence**

* Deploy PepsiCo tools (M\&W, digital MIS, process control, quality \& food safety protocols) across CoMan sites.
* Build the technical and operating capability of CoMan teams through structured training, audits, and coaching.

**3\. Commercial, Contractual \& Governance Responsibilities**

* Oversee administration of CoMan agreements including compliance, audit closures, controls, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, Procurement, and Supply Chain to shape contract terms, cost structures, and renewal decisions.

**4\. Network Expansion \& New Site Development**

* Lead technical due diligence, project scoping, feasibility, and layout approvals for new CoMan sites.
* Oversee trials, quality validation, commissioning, and stabilization of new lines (e.g., Kurkure, Puffs).
* Enable innovation and renovation launches routed through the CoMan network.

**5\. Supply Planning \& Materials Management Support**

* Align with Planning and Procurement on monthly SIP requirements and available CoMan capacities.
* Oversee RM/PM stock controls, obsolescence avoidance, and inventory discipline across CoMan sites.

**3\. Key Deliverables / KPIs**

* AOP Volumes delivery across COSO plants \& Coman at agreed service linked KPIs (viz Schedule adherence)
* Manufacturing Lines Efficiencies and Material Usage Efficiency
* Quality \& Food safety compliance: PepsiCo mandates, AIB, internal audits
* Safety performance (viz TRIR, LTI, behavioural safety compliance)
* Cost KPIs and Productivity
* Controls and Governance KPIs in manufacturing operations
* Coman performance scorecards, audit closures, contractual compliance
* Talent development \& bench KPI.
* ER/ Culture and Org Health Score for manufacturing.
* Statutory Compliance

**4\. Future\-Facing Responsibilities (Strategic Outlook)**

* Lead modernization and automation across Company owned manufacturing \& Coman sites .
* Shape long\-term manufacturing footprint strategy, including brownfield expansions and new Coman partnerships.
* Drive sustainability agenda across all sites—water, energy, waste, carbon reduction.
* Develop a future\-ready talent pipeline aligned with global PepsiCo capability frameworks.
* Build a resilient, agile manufacturing network supporting innovation, SKU complexity, and volume growth.


Qualifications:
* 12–15\+ years in FMCG manufacturing or supply chain; multi\-site leadership preferred.
* Strong background in plant operations, technical manufacturing, CoMan/partner management, and project leadership.
* Experience in large\-scale capability building and driving operational excellence.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strategic Manufacturing Leadership
* Technical and Operational Excellence
* Partner Influence \& Governance
* Change management \& Project Leadership
* Transformation mindset.
* People Leadership \& Frontline Capability Development
* Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management

description:
**Job Description:**  

  

**About ETS:**  

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

  

The People Generalist is a key member of the People Team, responsible for delivering high\-quality, consistent, and efficient operational HR support across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the People Operations Manager, this role partners closely with People Business Partners and other People team colleagues to ensure the smooth execution of core People processes, compliance with policies and regulations and ensuring an excellent employee experience. The People Generalist provides hands\-on support in all operational areas across the entire employee life cycle including data management, compliance, and offboarding, and offers ad hoc coordination and administrative support as needed.


This role will help support the role out and coordination of key People Team initiatives across ETS. Supporting our team in delivering continuous improvement, efficiencies and streamlining processes where possible.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Deliver day\-to\-day People operations (onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, HRIS administration, compliance), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and collaboration with the wider People Team and relevant subject matter experts.
* Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, providing guidance on People policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex issues as needed.
* Support People Business Partners with operational delivery, including employee relations coordination, performance management, engagement initiatives, and process alignment.
* Maintain accurate employee records and documentation in line with data privacy and compliance requirements; assist with HR reports, analytics, and dashboards, partnering with HRIS and Total Rewards as relevant.
* Coordinate and support the administration of benefits, payroll, and other employee programmes, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders if relevant in your country.
* Support the implementation and communication of People policies, procedures, and initiatives; participate in continuous improvement of People processes and employee experience.
* Provide administrative support for HR projects, audits, compliance activities, and the organisation of People Team events, training, and meetings.
* Foster a culture of self\-service, working with Internal Communications to ensure clear information for employees.
* Partner with stakeholder groups (e.g., IT, Finance, Marketing) to ensure People Team processes are effective, on brand, and aligned.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory standards, and agreed SLAs for People Operations
* Remain flexible and adaptable, supporting ad hoc requests and administration or coordination as directed by the People Consulting or Operations group.

  

**Experience and Skills:**
Qualifications:


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years' experience in an HR, People Operations, or administrative role, ideally in a fast\-paced or complex environment.
* Experience supporting HR processes such as onboarding, data management, or employee relations is desirable.
* Exposure to HR systems and data management preferred.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, service\-driven environment.
* Experience working in a global organization is preferred

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS


* Basic understanding of financial concepts (e.g., budgets, cost drivers) to support HR\-related administration and queries.
* Awareness of business context and priorities to help align day\-to\-day people practices with team needs.
* Ability to accurately handle HR data, maintain records, and assist with basic reporting.
* Recognises issues or patterns in employee or team challenges and knows when to escalate for resolution.
* Developing commercial awareness and understanding of how HR supports business operations.
* Works collaboratively with colleagues across HR and other departments to deliver effective service.
* Supports change initiatives by helping with communications, gathering feedback, and assisting teams through transitions.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills; able to manage multiple tasks and respond to urgent needs.
* Practical problem\-solving skills; able to suggest solutions to routine people\-related challenges.
* Demonstrates initiative by using available information, tools and resources to respond to and resolve employee queries, seeking guidance only when necessary, rather than waiting for direct instruction.

We are seeking Analyst (Finance) to join our Shared Services FP\&A/Management Reporting team, responsible to maintain and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting. This position will support Shared Services finance operations by managing expense research and reclasses, accruals, prepaids, amortization, balance sheet reconciliations, budgeting, forecasting, and allocation support. The role partners closely with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Shared Services FP\&A, and business stakeholders to ensure accurate financial reporting, budget alignment, and timely month\-end close activities.  



This role involves handling confidential financial information and requires strong coordination across Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, HR, and Strategy teams.  


**Key Responsibilities:**
**Expense Research \& Reclasses**
* Act as a point of contact for expense\-related queries from business operations teams.
* Research expense issues, identify root causes, and provide findings back to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with source teams (AP, Telecom, Accounting) to correct expense coding.
* Identify appropriate cost centers and prepare journal entries for expense reclasses.
* Manage and track expense requests through to closure using a structured queue/inbox approach.

  


**Accruals, Prepaids \& Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
* Monitor monthly accruals in partnership with Accounting and AP teams.
* Track and manage prepaids and amortization schedules.
* Support balance sheet reconciliations in line with GAAP requirements.
* Review accuracy of accruals post\-close and highlight variances.
* Assist with transition of accrual monitoring responsibilities from accounting.

  


**Labor Reclasses \& Budget Alignment**
* Prepare monthly labor and cost reclass journal entries to align actuals with approved budgets.
* Support business areas where costs need to be shifted or corrected post\-close.
* Ensure reclasses are well\-documented and auditable.


**Budgeting Support**
* Partner with Shared Services FP\&A to learn and operate the budgeting tool.
* Support budget preparation, uploads, and reconciliations across supported functions.
* Coordinate with Finance Managers to ensure timely and accurate budget submissions.

  


**Forecasting \& Reporting**
* Prepare monthly forecasts for assigned divisions.
* Review forecasts with Shared Services FP\&A analysts prior to submission.
* Support submission of forecasts to Central Shared Services teams as per workday timelines
* Assist with variance analysis and forecast commentary.

  


**Allocations \& Systems Support**
* Act as backup support for shared services allocation processes.
* Assist with preparation and review of allocation true\-ups.
* Support budgeting governance, financial models, reconciliations, and system updates.
* Contribute to Power BI (PBI) refreshes and preparation of insights and narratives.


**Continuous Improvement \& Transition Support**
* Support transition of additional Shared Services divisions as scope expands.
* Assist with capital labor reconciliations as required.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization and efficiency improvements.
* Work closely with the global stakeholders to process and ensure accurate recording (Accruals, Amortization, Allocation, Reclass, etc), reporting, consolidation and analyzing reports pertaining to General ledger accounting
* Active participation in performing the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing process.
* Extract, modify and analyze monthly reports as required and resolve queries.
* Perform General ledger related audit deliverables during audit.
* Periodic updation of SOP's to make sure any process changes, exceptions and new learnings are updated timely.

  


**Key Stakeholders**
* Shared Services FP\&A
* Accounting \& Accounts Payable
* Business Operations (Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Legal, HR, Strategy, IT)
* Central Shared Services Finance Teams

  


**Skills \& Qualifications:**  


**Education:** Preferably CMA / MBA / M.com / Semi qualified with 2 to 4 years (or) CA / CPA with 1 to 2 years of experience in General ledger accounting  


**Technical Skills:**
* Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals (accruals, prepaids, amortization).
* Experience with journal entries, reconciliations, and month\-end close activities.
* Exposure to budgeting and forecasting processes.
* Strong Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros, VBA preferred); experience with financial systems/tools preferred.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience with Power BI for data uploading and reporting.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll build and run our whole People \& Culture function — starting from almost nothing — and turn People into one of the company's real strengths. This is a hands\-on leadership job: senior enough to design the system, close enough to still hire a key person yourself. You'll report to the CEO and own the result, not a task list.
 



  





**What you'll own, end to end:** 



* **Hiring** 
 — build the pipeline, the process, and our name as an employer, so the founders don't have to find people themselves.
* **HR Operations \& Compliance** 
 — keep our HR system clean and current, handle payroll inputs and legal compliance (PF, ESI, POSH), and give every new hire a smooth start.
* **Performance** 
 — set clear goals, run the review cycle, and work with the founders to help every person do their best.
* **Culture \& Engagement** 
 — bring our values to life, keep a pulse on how people feel, and keep attrition low.
* **Learning \& AI** 
 — set up onboarding, run regular training, and get the team using AI in daily work.
* **People \& Team** 
 — plan ahead for hiring, advise the CEO, and build and lead a small People team of 3–5 that grows with the company.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 25\+ roles closed this year, all top\-quality hires
* HR system clean and current, every offer letter out within 48 hours
* Every employee working to clear quarterly goals, with the first full review cycle done on time
* First engagement survey run with 80%\+ taking part, and attrition held at 15% or below
* Proper onboarding for every hire, AI used across the company, and a quarterly training calendar delivered



  





**Must Have** 



* **You've led and scaled** 
**8–12 years in HR** 
 , with at least 3–4 years leading a team and helped grow a company's headcount.
* **A hiring track record you can prove** 
 — specific people you've hired, with titles and dates, including a senior role you closed yourself.
* **You've built, not maintained** 
 — set up an HR function from scratch.
* **All\-round HR judgment** 
 — operations, compliance, performance, and culture, not just one part.
* **You know your numbers** 
 — time\-to\-fill, offer acceptance, and attrition, off the top of your head.
* **You're in Kolkata** 
 , or can move here within 30 days.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Structured hiring methods — scorecards and proper reference checks
* Experience running a company on a system like Scaling Up, EOS, or OKRs
* Business sense — you read the commercial side, not just the people side
* AI in your work today — you can show a real way you use it, not just talk about it



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



**Apply — let's talk.**

title: Strategic HR Officer
description:
Job Title
 



 Strategic HR Officer to ED \& CTO
 



 (Role designed to evolve into Chief People Officer within 24 months)
 



 Location: Panchkula \| India
 



 Reports To: Executive Director and Chief Technology Officer
 



 The Opportunity: The ED \& CTO’s People Architect
 



 This is not a conventional HR leadership role. It is a transformational leadership track designed for a high\-potential people strategist to work directly under the mentorship of the ED \& CTO, with the mandate to architect the organization’s long\-term people philosophy, leadership ecosystem, and cultural infrastructure.
 



 You will enter a financially robust, zero\-debt, globally operating pharmaceutical organization with revenues of \~₹750 Cr and a workforce of 1500\+ professionals across India and international operations. The company believes that sustainable business growth is impossible without disciplined people systems, ethical leadership, operational accountability, and a deeply aligned organizational culture.
 



 This role is designed for a future\-ready HR leader who can integrate Strategy, Culture, Leadership Development, Workforce Planning, Organizational Design, Performance Systems, and Talent Intelligence into one cohesive people architecture.
 



 You will not merely manage HR — you will help design the human engine that powers the company’s next decade of growth.
 



 Role Objective
 



 This role is architected as an accelerated leadership catalyst intended to shape a future enterprise\-level People Leader and strategic advisor to the ED \& CTO.
 



 As the Strategic HR Officer to ED \& CTO, you will operate as an extension of the ED \& CTO’s office with unrestricted exposure across:
 


* Human Capital Strategy
* Leadership Development
* Organizational Design
* Industrial Relations
* Compensation \& Rewards
* Talent Acquisition
* Culture \& Employer Branding
* HR Governance \& Compliance
* Workforce Productivity
* Learning \& Capability Building



 You will not simply oversee HR functions — you will be trained to understand the deeper relationship between:
 


* Business growth and workforce capability
* Leadership quality and operational excellence
* Culture and long\-term institutional sustainability
* Productivity and people economics
* Governance and organizational trust



  





 The Mission
 



 To undergo an intensive 24\-month leadership immersion that transitions you from a strategic HR professional into the organization’s principal custodian of People, Culture, Leadership, and Organizational Effectiveness.
 



 By the end of this journey, you are expected to independently lead enterprise\-wide people strategy, build future leadership pipelines, shape culture at scale, and act as a trusted advisor to the ED \& CTO on all human capital matters.
 



 Role Structure \& Progression
 



 Phase 1: Organizational Immersion \& Cultural Understanding (Months 0–6\)
 



 The goal: Understand “The People Behind the Business.”
 



 Key Exposure Areas:
 


* Rotational Deep Dives across:
* Talent Acquisition
* HR Operations
* Payroll \& Compliance
* Learning \& Development
* Manufacturing HR
* Employee Relations
* Corporate HR
* Industrial Relations
* Leadership Shadowing:
* Shadow the ED \& CTO in leadership reviews, strategic meetings, and high\-level people discussions
* Attend functional reviews to understand leadership styles and organizational dynamics
* Culture Mapping Exercise:
* Conduct structured interactions with employees across plants, HO, sales, and international teams
* Identify cultural strengths, hidden bottlenecks, communication gaps, and leadership dependencies
* HR Governance Exposure:
* Participate in policy reviews, disciplinary proceedings, compliance audits, and labor law governance processes
* Employer Brand Analysis:
* Evaluate the organization’s current employer positioning and benchmark against industry talent standards



 Phase 2: Functional Ownership \& People Operations Execution (Months 6–12\)
 



 The goal: Move from observation to operational ownership.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Independently lead one complete hiring vertical or business function
* Drive one enterprise\-wide HR improvement initiative
* Manage quarterly manpower planning exercises
* Lead performance management coordination for one business division
* Handle critical employee grievance resolutions under supervision
* Coordinate one annual engagement survey and action planning process
* Begin mentoring junior HR team members and management trainees



 Strategic Projects:
 


* Improve hiring turnaround time
* Reduce attrition in critical functions
* Design competency frameworks for key managerial roles
* Build structured onboarding and probation review systems



 Phase 3: Strategic Leadership \& Organizational Transformation (Months 12–18\)
 



 The goal: Demonstrate leadership maturity and strategic capability.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Lead a major cross\-functional transformation initiative such as:
* Leadership Development Framework
* Succession Planning Architecture
* HRMS/ERP implementation
* Performance\-linked incentive redesign
* Organizational restructuring
* Manufacturing productivity\-linked workforce optimization
* Leadership Advisory:
* Actively support CXOs and business heads in manpower planning and team effectiveness
* Workforce Analytics:
* Build data\-driven dashboards for:
* Attrition
* Productivity
* Hiring efficiency
* Talent pipeline health
* Leadership readiness
* Employee engagement
* Policy Architecture:
* Draft or redesign key HR policies aligned with organizational growth and governance needs
* Leadership Development:
* Design and facilitate managerial capability\-building interventions



 Phase 4: Transition to Enterprise Leadership (Months 18–24\)
 



 The goal: Operate as the de\-facto People Leader before formal designation.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Function as Acting Head of HR for day\-to\-day strategic and operational decisions
* Independently lead annual manpower budgeting and workforce strategy planning
* Present enterprise\-level people dashboards to Board/Leadership
* Lead succession planning discussions for critical roles
* Drive culture alignment initiatives across all business units
* Manage senior leadership hiring and executive talent conversations
* Demonstrate independent command over:
* HR governance
* Industrial relations
* Workforce planning
* Compensation strategy
* Talent systems
* Organizational culture



 Final Evaluation:
 



 A formal leadership assessment at Month 24 evaluating:
 


* Strategic maturity
* Leadership influence
* Cultural alignment
* Governance capability
* Business understanding
* Organizational impact



 Upon successful completion, you will formally assumes the role of Chief People Officer (CPO).
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Strategic Workforce \& Organizational Planning
 


* Design workforce strategies aligned with long\-term business growth
* Build scalable organizational structures capable of supporting global expansion
* Forecast leadership and capability requirements proactively
* Create succession pipelines for critical business functions



 2\. Leadership Development \& Culture Building
 


* Build a strong leadership culture rooted in accountability, humility, ownership, and execution excellence
* Design leadership competency frameworks across levels
* Drive coaching, mentoring, and capability\-building initiatives
* Strengthen organizational alignment with the company’s values and philosophy



 3\. Talent Acquisition \& Employer Branding
 


* Build world\-class talent acquisition systems for leadership and critical roles
* Position the organization as an employer of choice within the pharmaceutical and manufacturing ecosystem
* Develop strategic hiring partnerships with institutes, networks, and industry forums
* Improve candidate experience and employer perception



 4\. Performance Management \& Productivity Enhancement
 


* Redesign performance systems to drive meritocracy and accountability
* Establish measurable KPIs and productivity frameworks
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and execution discipline
* Align rewards and recognition systems with business outcomes



 5\. Employee Relations \& Industrial Harmony
 


* Maintain healthy industrial relations across manufacturing operations
* Build trust\-driven employee engagement systems
* Handle sensitive employee relations matters with maturity and fairness
* Ensure organizational discipline without compromising culture and morale



 6\. HR Governance, Compliance \& Ethics
 


* Ensure full compliance with labor laws, statutory obligations, and HR governance standards
* Build strong policy frameworks and ethical practices
* Strengthen HR audit readiness across functions
* Promote fairness, transparency, and organizational trust



 7\. HR Technology \& Data Intelligence
 


* Build technology\-enabled HR ecosystems using HRMS, analytics, automation, and dashboards
* Leverage people analytics for strategic decision\-making
* Use data to identify retention risks, leadership gaps, and productivity bottlenecks
* Drive digital transformation within HR operations



 Desired Candidate Profile
 



 Educational Qualifications
 


* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or related specialization from a tier\-1 institute
* Additional certifications in Leadership Development, OD, Industrial Relations, Coaching, or Analytics will be an advantage
* 1\-5 years of experience



 Essential Attributes (The “Venus DNA”)
 



 Intellectual Depth
 



 Ability to understand the complex relationship between business growth, culture, leadership, and people systems.
 



 Leadership Gravitas
 



 Capability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge respectfully, and drive alignment across functions.
 



 Cultural Intelligence
 



 Ability to balance empathy with accountability while shaping a high\-performance culture.
 



 Ethical Backbone
 



 Uncompromising integrity, fairness, and confidentiality in all people decisions.
 



 Operational Discipline
 



 Strong execution orientation with attention to detail and governance.
 



 Business Orientation
 



 Ability to think beyond HR and understand the operational and financial realities of the organization.
 



 Tech\-Native HR Mindset
 



 Comfortable with HR analytics, dashboards, AI\-enabled HR systems, and technology\-driven people management.
 



 Why Choose This Path?
 



 Direct Mentorship from the ED \& CTO
 



 You will work directly with the organization’s top leadership and gain unrestricted strategic exposure.

title: Trainee HR- Operations
description:
About the Company
  
  

Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading IT solutions provider with over 30 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, and Managed Services. Headquartered in Mumbai, we are committed to delivering innovative technology solutions while building a strong and talented workforce.
  
About the Role
  
  

Kickstart your career in Human Resources with Swan Solutions!
  
  

We are looking for enthusiastic and detail\-oriented fresh graduates to join our HR team as an Trainee HR – Operations . This role offers hands\-on exposure to the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, documentation, background verification, HR operations, and employee record management.
  
  

Selected candidates will undergo a 3\-month training program on stipend . Upon successful completion of the training and performance evaluation, candidates will be confirmed as full\-time employees on the company payroll .
  
  

**Location:** Andheri East, Saki Naka – Mumbai
  
  

**Department:** Human Resources
  
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  
  

**Training Period:** 3 Months (Stipend)
  
  

**Experience:** Freshers
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

Coordinate pre\-joining and post\-joining activities.
  
  

Collect, verify, and maintain employee documents.
  
  

Process onboarding documentation and employee records.
  
  

Coordinate Background Verification and follow up for completion.
  
  

Prepare and issue Offer Letters, Stipend Letters, Appointment Letters, Confirmation Letters, Experience Letters, and other HR documents.
  
  

Maintain employee files, HR MIS, and onboarding trackers.
  
  

Coordinate induction and onboarding activities with internal teams.
  
  

Assist with employee confirmations, transfers, exits, and HR documentation.
  
  

Ensure employee records are accurate, updated, and compliant with company policies.
  
  

Support day\-to\-day HR Operations and administrative activities.
  
  

Preferred Educational Qualification \& Skills
  
  

Graduate in any discipline.
  
  

Freshers are encouraged to apply.
  
  

Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  

Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  
  

Attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
  
  

Eagerness to learn and build a career in HR Operations.
  
  

What We Offer
  
  

Structured 3\-month training program with a monthly stipend.
  
  

Hands\-on experience in HR Operations and employee lifecycle management.
  
  

Practical exposure to onboarding, documentation, BGV, compliance, and HR processes.
  
  

Learning and mentoring from experienced HR professionals.
  
  

Opportunity to become a full\-time employee on the company payroll after successful completion of the training period.
  
  

Career growth in Human Resources.
  
  

Ready to Join Us?
  
  

If you’re looking to start your HR career with practical experience in HR Operations, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  

Apply today and grow your career with Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd.

title: Employee Relations Lead
description:
* Experience in handling compliance relevant to Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
* End‑to‑end POSH case lifecycle, including intake, preliminary assessment, investigation oversight, inquiry proceedings, recommendations, and closure
* Act as a central governance owner for POSH implementation across locations and units
* Drive periodic policy reviews and updates, aligned to legal, regulatory, and organizational changes
* Oversee constitution, renewal, and effectiveness of Internal Committees (ICs) and Local Committees, as applicable
* Ensure cases are handled with neutrality, confidentiality, timeliness, and procedural fairness
* Guide IC members on inquiry processes, evidence evaluation, principles of natural justice, and documentation standards
* Coordinate with ER, Legal, HRBPs, and Leadership on recommendations and consequence management
* Track case metrics, timelines, outcomes, and trends while maintaining data privacy
* Design and deliver POSH awareness and sensitization programs for employees, managers, IC members, and leadership
* Drive continuous education initiatives through e‑learning, campaigns, workshops, and induction programs

title: Job Description – Junior Sales Executive (Freshers)
description:
Job Description – Job Description – Junior Sales Executive (Freshers)

Company: Predictive Research Inc.

Website: https://www.predictiveresearchinc.com

Number of Positions: 05

Work Locations

Bengaluru (JP Nagar), Karnataka

Siruguppa (Ballari District), Karnataka

About Predictive Research Inc.

Predictive Research Inc. is a leading Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Data Science, and Quantitative Analytics company with over 10 years of experience delivering advanced technology solutions for domestic and international clients.

We specialize in developing cutting\-edge AI\-driven products and providing data\-driven solutions across multiple industries. Our organization offers an excellent learning environment where fresh graduates receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and exposure to real\-world client projects.

Our Core Expertise

Machine Learning \& Artificial Intelligence

Neural Networks \& Deep Learning

Big Data Engineering

Data Science

Quantitative \& Financial Analytics

Position

Machine Learning Engineer / Analyst (Freshers)

This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates who are passionate about building a career in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, and Quantitative Analytics.

Selected candidates will undergo structured on\-the\-job training while working alongside experienced Data Scientists and ML Engineers on live client projects.

For Any Graduate (BBA, B.Com, BCA, BA, B.Sc, BE/B.Tech, MBA Freshers)

YearCompensation1st Year₹2\.76 LPA (Training \+ Client Project Exposure) 2nd Year₹3\.36 LPA \+ Performance Incentives 3rd Year₹4\.56 LPA \+ Performance Incentives

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, and other sales channels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science solutions.
* Schedule product demonstrations and client meetings.
* Follow up with leads and convert them into business opportunities.
* Maintain CRM records and sales reports accurately.
* Collaborate with technical and marketing teams to prepare proposals and presentations.
* Meet monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Continuously learn about the company's products, services, and industry trends.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Good negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Basic understanding of sales and business development concepts.
* Willingness to learn technology products and AI solutions.
* Self\-motivated with a positive attitude.
* Good problem\-solving and customer\-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and CRM tools is an advantage.

EligibilityEducational Qualifications

* Any Graduate (BBA, B.Com, BCA, BA, B.Sc, BE/B.Tech)
* MBA (Marketing, Sales, Business Management)
* Freshers graduating in 2025 or 2026 are encouraged to apply.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who

* Have a passion for sales and business development.
* Possess excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Are confident interacting with clients and decision\-makers.
* Are willing to invest three years in professional learning and career growth.
* Are comfortable signing a **3\-year employment agreement**.
* Agree to submit original academic documents during the contract period as per company policy.
* Are willing to relocate to **JP Nagar, Bengaluru**.
* Enjoy working in a target\-driven and collaborative environment.

What You Will Gain During the 3\-Year Program

At Predictive Research Inc., we believe in developing future business leaders.

During the program, candidates will receive:

* Hands\-on experience in B2B technology sales.
* Professional sales and business development training.
* Exposure to domestic and international clients.
* Practical experience selling AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science solutions.
* Mentorship from experienced sales and business leaders.
* Training in CRM systems, lead generation, negotiation, and client management.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Experience working with enterprise clients.
* Opportunity to build a successful career in technology sales.
* Significant enhancement in professional credibility and employability.

Career Opportunities After Successfully Completing the Program

title: Automation & Data Analyst
description:
**JOLLY CLAMPS PVT. LTD.**

Manufacturers of Steel Clamps \& Couplings

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position**

Automation \& Data Analyst (Manufacturing Operations)

**Department**

Automation \& Systems

**Location**

Goregaon (Head Office) \+ Virar (Factory) — travel between both required

**Experience**

1–2 years

**Reports To**

Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

**Employment**

Full\-time, on\-site

About the Role

Jolly Clamps Pvt. Ltd. (JCPL) is building in\-house capability to automate its manufacturing operations and bring its inventory, work\-in\-progress (WIP) and costing data under tight, reliable control. This is a hands\-on role for someone in their career who wants to excel in how a real manufacturing business runs and turn its day\-to\-day data into dependable dashboards, reports and small applications.

You will work closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the operations and information technology (IT) teams, and the shop floor across both the Goregaon head office and the Virar factory. Full training and mentoring will be provided; what matters most is a genuine appetite to learn, attention to detail, and comfort working with data.

**Core principles you will be trained to follow:**

* rely on a single, agreed source of data rather than scattered reports;
* use clear, deterministic (rule\-based) computation that anyone can audit, with no guesswork;
* always validate a solution on one test case before scaling it across the plant.

Key Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the CFO and senior team members, you will support, build and maintain the following. You are not expected to do all of this on day one — you will be brought up to speed project by project.

***Production Planning \& Control (PPC) — Python\-based Planning Solutions***

A central part of the role is helping build and run a suite of Python\-based tools that turn the monthly Sales forecast into a realistic, committed production plan. Working with the planning and operations teams, you will support:

* **Planning engine (demand to commitment):** Build and maintain the monthly planning engine that converts the Sales forecast (received item\-wise and family\-wise from the enterprise resource planning system) into a deliverable commitment, running demand against line capacity, manpower and material limits to produce the family\-wise quantity committed to Sales.
* **Forecast cleanup \& common\-part master:** Automate cleanup and filtration of the location\-wise forecast by grouping stock\-keeping units (SKUs) that share a common internal part code into a single common part, replacing the manual pivot; create and maintain the master that maps customer and location SKUs to the common\-part code.
* **Capacity, manpower \& occupancy model:** Automate the family\-wise line\-capacity and manpower model to compute shift\-wise occupancy percentage, flag demand exceeding both shifts as over\-capacity, and base commitments on current manpower, allowing for the recruitment lead time.
* **Economic batch quantity batching:** Hold the economic batch quantity (EBQ) per item as a clean master and build batching logic that defaults to it, quantifying the efficiency loss when priority orders break the batch and trigger extra changeovers.
* **Make\-to\-stock stock\-level prioritisation:** Automate the colour\-coded make\-to\-stock , stock\-level sheet and auto\-sequence production so the most critical parts are made first, replacing the heavy manual spreadsheet.
* **Trading\-conversion \& excess\-production traceability:** Build logic that traces production booked against a common part, the trading\-conversion transfers to individual customer codes and the residual balance, so excess production is attributed to the Sales order that drove it and made visible to Sales.
* **Demand cadence by customer type:** Encode the differing demand cadences by customer type (aftermarket weekly; regular original\-equipment\-manufacturer customers on a weekly cycle; trigger\-based customers daily) into the plan, along with the buffer and overtime catch\-up mechanism used to meet the required daily rate.
* **Material requirement planning:** Extend the planning engine to derive raw\-material and child\-part requirements from the committed family and item plan and batch quantities, so procurement is driven by the confirmed plan and checked against stock and open purchase orders.

***Data Reconciliation \& Control Reports (rule\-based, auditable)***

* Daily inventory reconciliation reports (opening stock plus purchases, less consumption, equals closing stock; and finished goods produced versus dispatched).
* Material\-balance checks that reconcile input against output, scrap and work\-in\-progress (WIP) movement, allowing for normal process weight and measurement tolerances.
* Consumption\-based costing reports that value material on actual usage rather than purchases, organised by cost centre.
* Reclassification of items between make\-to\-stock and make\-to\-order based on demand trends.
* Exception and error\-tracking reports that flag wrong, reversed, delayed or duplicate transactions, along with their likely cause.
* Threshold\-based monitoring (for example, inventory or work\-in\-progress above an agreed reference level) with automatic alert notifications.

***Workflow Automation***

* Help set up the scheduled extraction of system reports, with automatic pickup and processing into daily reconciliations.
* Support automated report extraction through application programming interfaces (API) feeding business intelligence (BI) dashboards.
* Assist in consolidating overlapping automation tools onto a single, governed workflow platform.

***Data\-Capture Applications \& Dashboards***

* Support data\-capture applications that record activity at source (plan versus actual, productivity, adherence), with a database behind them and a link to the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
* Help deploy point\-of\-source data capture using fixed screens or tablets feeding a central database and live dashboards.

***System Controls (with the IT team)***

* Help implement controls that prevent item, grade or master\-data mismatch, with daily exception reporting.
* Support duplicate\-entry prevention using unique transaction identifiers and a holding area for failed entries.
* Assist in evaluating a warehouse management system (WMS) and its integration with the ERP.

***General***

* Validate every report and tool against real data before it is relied upon.
* Document what you build so others can understand and maintain it.
* Coordinate with stores, shop\-floor, accounts and IT colleagues to keep data accurate and on time.

Skills \& Knowledge

***Essential (foundational level is acceptable for a fresher)***

* **Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java :** Working knowledge of Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java for data handling, building planning and reconciliation logic, and simple automation.
* **Data / spreadsheets:** Comfort with spreadsheets, formulas and structured data; willingness to learn Power Query and business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI.
* **Databases:** Basic understanding of databases and the ability to write simple structured query language (SQL) queries.
* **Logic \& accuracy:** Strong attention to detail and a logical, methodical approach to problem\-solving.
* **Communication:** Clear written and spoken communication, able to explain a number or a report simply.

***Desirable (a plus, not required — training will be given)***

* **Automation tools:** Exposure to a workflow automation platform (for example, low\-code or no\-code tools).
* **App building:** Any experience building small web pages, dashboards or applications.
* **ERP / systems:** Familiarity with an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system or how factory data is recorded.
* **Programming:** Basic Java or any second programming language.
* **Domain interest:** Curiosity about manufacturing, production planning, inventory, costing and operations.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, commerce or a related field; or equivalent demonstrated ability.
* Graduates with relevant projects, internships or self\-built work (for example, dashboards, small applications or automations) are encouraged to apply.
* Practical evidence of your work — a portfolio, project links or samples — is valued alongside formal qualifications.

What the Role Offers

* Direct mentoring from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and senior operations and finance leaders.
* Real ownership of meaningful projects on a live factory floor, not theoretical exercises.
* Broad exposure across finance, operations, inventory, costing and information technology in one role.
* A clear path to grow into a specialist automation, data or systems position as you develop.

*Please mention your willingness to travel between the Goregaon office and the Virar factory.*

description:

Navi Mumbai (On\-Site)

Internship
  
Job Description


**Project Overview**
--------------------


We are looking for a highly motivated R\&D Intern to support the integration of AI\-based flight control algorithms into the PX4 Autopilot framework.


The project focuses on deploying pre\-trained neural network models (including Feedforward Neural Networks, LSTM, and GRU architectures) for UAV attitude control and payload control. The selected intern will primarily research, design, and implement the most suitable approach for integrating these trained models into the PX4 ecosystem, enabling deployment and validation on a real quadcopter platform.


This is an excellent opportunity for candidates interested in autonomous systems, UAVs, artificial intelligence, robotics, and embedded flight control.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Study the PX4 Autopilot architecture and identify suitable integration points for AI\-based controllers.
* Research and recommend the most effective methodology for integrating pre\-trained neural network models into PX4\.
* Integrate trained AI models (Simple Neural Networks, LSTM, and GRU) into the PX4 flight control framework.
* Support deployment and testing using PX4 SITL/Gazebo simulation before hardware implementation.
* Assist in deploying and validating the integrated controller on a quadcopter.
* Collaborate with the research team to troubleshoot integration challenges and improve system performance.
* Document the integration workflow, implementation details, and experimental results.
  

  

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Good understanding of control systems fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of machine learning and deep neural networks.
* Familiarity with recurrent neural networks such as LSTM and GRU.
* Basic understanding of Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL).
* Strong programming skills in Python and C/C\+\+.
* **Mandatory:** Working knowledge of the PX4 Autopilot framework and its development environment.
* Familiarity with Git and Linux\-based development.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Experience with UAVs, drones, or robotic systems.
* Knowledge of ROS/ROS2 and MAVLink communication.
* Experience with Gazebo or PX4 SITL simulation.
* Familiarity with embedded systems and flight controller hardware.
* Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  

  

**Eligibility**
---------------


* Final\-year / undergraduate or postgraduate students in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines.
* Candidates with relevant personal or academic projects in PX4, UAVs, robotics, or AI are encouraged to apply.
  

  

**Expected Deliverables**
-------------------------


By the end of the internship, the intern is expected to:


* Develop a robust methodology for integrating AI\-based controllers into PX4\.
* Successfully integrate the provided trained neural network models within the PX4 Autopilot framework.
* Validate the integrated controller through simulation and, where feasible, real\-flight testing.
* Prepare clear technical documentation covering the integration process, implementation, and testing results.
  

  

**Duration**
------------


3 months (extendable)

  

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------


We are looking for a self\-driven and research\-oriented candidate who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems. The ideal candidate should be eager to learn, comfortable working with open\-source software, and capable of independently researching technical solutions while collaborating effectively with the R\&D team.

**Company:** InnoworQ Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹18,000 per month \+ Conveyance \+ Food \& Accommodation Allowances  
**Shift:** Night Shift (12:00 AM – 6:00 AM)

**Job Description**

InnoworQ Technologies is hiring **Field Engineers – Networking** to support preventive maintenance activities for Cisco networking infrastructure at customer locations. This role is ideal for freshers and early\-career networking professionals who are passionate about networking technologies and are willing to work in night shifts.

The selected candidates will visit customer sites during the scheduled maintenance window to perform preventive maintenance, health checks, basic troubleshooting, and documentation activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform preventive maintenance (PMT) and health checks on Cisco networking devices.

* Conduct basic troubleshooting of routers, switches, and networking equipment.
* Escalate critical issues to the NOC or senior network team.
* Complete PMT checklists and submit service reports on time.
* Follow customer SOPs, safety guidelines, and maintenance procedures.
* Coordinate with Team Leads and Project Managers for daily work updates.
* Maintain professional communication with customers during site visits.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Computer Networking.
* Knowledge of Routing, Switching, and Network Diagnostics.
* Familiarity with Cisco networking devices is preferred.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and travel to customer locations.
* Comfortable working regular night shifts.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree / Graduate in Electronics, IT, Computer Science, Networking, or a related discipline.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with 1\+ years of networking field experience will be preferred.
* CCNA certification is an added advantage (not mandatory).

**Mandatory Requirements**

Candidates must possess:

* Laptop
* Android Smartphone
* Basic toolkit (Blower, Screwdriver Set, etc.)
* Valid Government ID Proof

**Preferred Experience**

* ISP or Telecom field operations.
* Cisco ASR/NCS platform exposure.
* Immediate joiners will be given preference.

**Salary \& Benefits**

* Salary: **₹15,000 – ₹18,000 per month** (Based on experience)
* Conveyance Reimbursement:
* ₹3/km (Non\-Hill Areas)
* ₹4/km (Hill Areas)
* Food Allowance: ₹250/day for travel exceeding 80 km
* Accommodation Reimbursement:
* Up to ₹500/night (Team Lead Approval)
* Above ₹500/night (Manager Approval Required)

**Open Locations**

* Bangalore

**Why Join InnoworQ?**

* Opportunity to work on enterprise Cisco networking infrastructure.
* Excellent platform for freshers to build a career in Networking.
* Travel reimbursement and field allowances.
* Hands\-on experience in preventive maintenance and field operations.
* Career growth in Network Support and Infrastructure Services.

**If you are passionate about networking, willing to travel, and comfortable working night shifts, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and become a part of the InnoworQ team!**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month
