description:
**Job Description – Graphic Designer**

**Company:** Mumtree  
**Location:** Haridwar, Uttarakhand  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Marketing \& Product Design

**About Mumtree**

Mumtree is a growing kids’ play and furniture brand focused on creating innovative play equipment, wooden products, and experiential play spaces for homes and schools.

We are looking for a **creative and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer** who can translate ideas, products, and brand stories into effective visual designs across digital, e\-commerce, and product documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Social Media \& Marketing Designs**

* Create engaging creatives for Instagram, Facebook, and other digital platforms.
* Design social media posts, carousels, stories, ad creatives, and campaign graphics.
* Work with the marketing team to develop visually engaging content for product launches, offers, and brand campaigns.
* Adapt designs into different sizes and formats required for Meta Ads and other digital platforms.
* Maintain consistency with Mumtree’s brand identity and visual language.

**2\. Product Listing \& E\-commerce Designs**

* Design product listing images for the Mumtree website, marketplaces, and other e\-commerce platforms.
* Create product feature graphics, USP highlights, dimension graphics, comparison creatives, and usage visuals.
* Convert product photographs into clean and professional product presentation designs.
* Design product catalogues, brochures, and sales presentation material.
* Optimize visual communication to help customers easily understand product features and benefits.

**3\. Product Blueprint \& Technical Designs**

* Create clean and easy\-to\-understand **product blueprint designs and technical presentation sheets**.
* Develop product dimension layouts, installation diagrams, assembly instructions, and component illustrations.
* Convert rough sketches, product measurements, and design inputs into structured visual documentation.
* Coordinate with the production and product development team to understand product specifications.
* Maintain organized product design and blueprint files for future reference.

**4\. Brand \& Creative Design**

* Support the development and implementation of Mumtree’s visual identity.
* Design banners, standees, posters, packaging graphics, labels, and marketing collaterals.
* Create school project presentations and PlayLab concept visuals.
* Design company profiles, pitch presentations, and sales support material.
* Assist in developing creative concepts for new products and campaigns.

**5\. Photography \& Content Support**

* Assist the team in planning product photography and content requirements.
* Edit, retouch, and enhance product photographs.
* Remove or replace backgrounds and prepare images for digital and print use.
* Create simple product mockups and lifestyle compositions.
* Coordinate with the content and marketing team for reels, videos, and campaign content.

**6\. Other Creative Activities**

* Support the marketing, sales, and product teams with day\-to\-day design requirements.
* Research current design, kids’ product, play\-space, and e\-commerce visual trends.
* Organize and maintain Mumtree’s digital creative library.
* Develop templates to improve the speed and consistency of regular design work.
* Take ownership of creative projects from concept to final output.
* Perform other design and creative activities required as the brand grows.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in **Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, or similar graphic design tools**.
* Good understanding of Canva and digital design tools.
* Ability to create social media and e\-commerce product creatives.
* Basic understanding of product dimensions, technical drawings, and blueprint layouts.
* Strong sense of typography, layout, colour, and visual hierarchy.
* Good photo editing and image manipulation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with a D2C, e\-commerce, furniture, kids’ products, or manufacturing brand.
* Knowledge of Amazon and e\-commerce product listing design.
* Basic video editing and motion graphics skills.
* Familiarity with AI\-based creative and image\-generation tools.
* Basic understanding of AutoCAD, SketchUp, Blender, or other product design software will be an advantage.

**Experience**

**1–3 years of relevant graphic design experience.**

Freshers with a **strong portfolio and good technical design skills** may also apply.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Creative and curious
* Detail\-oriented
* Comfortable working with products and measurements
* Fast and adaptable
* Willing to experiment with new design tools and AI
* Able to understand a requirement and independently convert it into an effective visual design

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
BETSOL is a cloud\-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.
   

  

 BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best\-in\-class performance.
   

  

 BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for its customers.
   

  

 BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.
   

  

 We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, 401K, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.
   

  

 Learn more at betsol.com
   

  

****Job Description****
**About the Role**
 You will lead the design, architecture, implementation, and support of the organization's enterprise network infrastructure. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role responsible for building highly available, scalable, and secure networking environments across on premises and cloud platforms. You will provide architectural guidance, drive network modernization initiatives, and mentor network engineers while ensuring operational excellence and security best practices.
   

  

****Responsibilities ****
 Architect and implement enterprise network solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with business objectives.  Design, deploy, and support Layer 2 and Layer 3 network infrastructure, including switching, routing, wireless, VPN, firewall, and load\-balancing technologies.  Administer and optimize Cisco and Aruba switching environments, wireless access points, VPN infrastructure, FortiGate Next\-Generation Firewalls, and network monitoring solutions.  Design and support enterprise wireless networks using HPE Aruba and Ubiquiti UniFi access points, controllers, and cloud management platforms.  Implement network security controls and best practices across hybrid on\-premises and cloud environments.  Lead technical design reviews and provide mentorship and technical guidance to network engineers.  Drive network automation initiatives using scripting languages such as Python and Bash for configuration management, monitoring, and operational efficiency.  Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and troubleshooting activities for critical network outages and performance issues.  Develop, maintain, and enforce network architecture standards, engineering best practices, and secure interconnection guidelines.  Own and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, operational procedures, change management records, and architecture standards.  Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to deliver reliable and high performing network services.  Support and enhance 24x7 network monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence initiatives.
   

  

****Qualifications****
**Looking For **
 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise networking infrastructure design, implementation, and support.  Strong expertise in network architecture, routing, switching, wireless networking, and network security.  Experience managing enterprise\-grade networking environments with Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, and cloud networking technologies.  Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, solve complex networking challenges, and work independently.  CCNA or CCNP certification is mandatory.
   

  

****Mandatory Skills****
* Technical Skills  Expert\-level understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking concepts including VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP, VTP, EtherChannel, and VRF.  Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco switching technologies, including configuration, troubleshooting, and high\-availability deployments.  Strong hands\-on experience with Aruba switching platforms, including ArubaOS, CLI configuration, VSF/stacking, and VLAN management.  Extensive experience with FortiGate Next\-Generation Firewalls, including VPNs, IPS, SD\-WAN, HA, and security policy management.  Strong understanding of network security principles, segmentation, access control, and secure network design.  Experience implementing highly available and resilient network architectures.  Knowledge of Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IDS/IPS technologies, and DDoS mitigation strategies.  Expertise with network troubleshooting and analysis tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, and Nmap.  Strong packet analysis, troubleshooting, and log analysis capabilities.  Familiarity with Windows Server networking services including Active Directory, DHCP, and DNS.  Hands\-on experience with HPE Aruba wireless solutions, including Aruba Controllers, Aruba Central, AP deployment, and RF optimization.  Hands\-on experience deploying and troubleshooting Ubiquiti UniFi Controllers and Access Points.  Knowledge of Azure and AWS networking concepts, including VNet, VPC, peering, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and Security Groups.  Experience with network automation and scripting using Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Soft Skills 


 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving abilities.  Ability to work independently and drive complex technical initiatives.  Strong documentation and technical writing capabilities.  Ability to mentor team members and provide technical leadership.  Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams. Good to Have Skills  Fortinet NSE certification.  Aruba networking certifications.  Experience with enterprise network monitoring and observability platforms.  Exposure to hybrid cloud networking architectures.  Experience with network automation frameworks and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions.  Knowledge of SD\-WAN implementations and advanced network security architectures.
   

  

**Mandatory Certifications: **
 CCNA or CCNP Preferred Certifications:  Fortinet NSE  Aruba Certified Professional or equivalent Aruba certifications
   

  

****Qualifications****
**Additional Information**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Control Systems Engineer
description:
Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space\-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across regimes, allowing end users to have actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception, comprehension, and prediction. This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor Resident Space Objects in orbit and support operational decision making.
   

  

 Digantara is seeking a Control systems design and hardware integration engineer to design, simulate, implement, test, and deploy closed\-loop stabilization systems for electro\-mechanical platforms used in precision sensing and tracking applications. The engineer shall translate top\-level requirements into control\-system architecture, perform modelling and simulations, select suitable sensors, actuators, controllers and embedded hardware, carry out programming and integration, and validate the deployed system against performance requirements in laboratory and field conditions.
   

  

 Why Us?
   

  

* Competitive incentives, galvanizing workspace, blazing team, frequent outings \- pretty much everything you have heard about a startup \+ you get to work on space technology.
* Hustle in a well\-funded startup, allowing you to take charge of your responsibilities and create your moonshot.


**Responsibilities**
* Carry out end\-to\-end control\-system design based on top\-level requirements, tracking, bandwidth, jitter and settling\-time requirements.
* Develop mathematical and simulation models for mechanical platforms, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, disturbances, and control\-loop behaviour.
* Design closed\-loop control architectures such as PID, feed\-forward control, disturbance rejection, and sensor\-fusion based stabilization as applicable.
* Perform simulations to estimate loop stability, phase/gain margins, bandwidth, disturbance attenuation, error estimation, residual jitter and sensitivity to parameter variations.
* Define specifications for sensors and hardware, including IMU/gyros, motor drivers, servo drives, motion controllers, embedded controllers, power electronics and safety interlocks.
* Identify suitable COTS components meeting system\-level requirements and prepare trade\-off studies covering performance, interface compatibility etc
* Develop embedded software/firmware and real\-time control code for controller deployment using suitable platforms depending on system requirements.
* Integrate sensors, actuators, drives, controller hardware and host software; implement calibration routines, data logging, telemetry, health monitoring and fault handling.
* Carry out lab testing, validation, tuning, system identification, frequency\-response testing, disturbance injection and closed\-loop performance verification.
* Support field deployment of stabilization systems on ground, mobile, marine or telescope platforms and perform acceptance testing against the specified accuracy requirements.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, optics, software and systems engineering teams to ensure that the integrated platform meets mission\-level requirements.


 Required Qualification
   

  

* 3\-8 years of academic, research or industry experience with significant aptitude in control systems, mechatronics, robotics, precision pointing, servo control or platform stabilization.
* Master’s degree in control systems, electrical/electronics engineering, mechatronics, robotics, instrumentation, aerospace engineering or a related field. Strong bachelor’s candidates with relevant hands\-on experience may also be considered.
* Experience in modelling and control of electro\-mechanical systems, gimbals, stabilized platforms, motor\-driven mechanisms, telescope mounts, antenna pointing systems, robotics systems.
* Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for modelling, control design, simulation, numerical analysis and data processing.
* Strong understanding of classical and modern control concepts including transfer functions, state\-space models, Bode plots, root locus, stability margins, tuning, filters, observers and disturbance rejection.
* Experience with sensors and actuators used in stabilization systems, including IMUs, gyroscopes, encoders, servo motors, BLDC motors, stepper motors, torque motors, and motor drivers.
* Experience with embedded programming in C/C\+\+ or equivalent and familiarity with real\-time implementation constraints such as sampling rates, latency, quantization, interrupt handling and communication timing.
* Familiarity with hardware testing equipment and methodologies including oscilloscopes, logic analysers, signal generators, data acquisition systems, motor drive configuration tools and vibration/disturbance measurement methods.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills with the ability to translate performance requirements into component specifications and testable design margins.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with stabilized optical payloads, telescope platforms, antenna pointing systems, inertial stabilization, fast steering mirrors, fine pointing assemblies or marine/vehicle\-mounted payload stabilization.
* Experience with system identification, frequency\-response measurement, hardware testing, real\-time simulation, digital filtering and sensor fusion.
* Experience with industrial or embedded communication interfaces such as CAN, EtherCAT, RS\-422/RS\-485, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, UDP/TCP, Modbus or similar.
* Experience with control deployment on STM32/TI C2000, Speedgoat/dSPACE, NI cRIO, Raspberry Pi/Jetson, real\-time Linux, FPGA or commercial motion\-control platforms.
* Understanding of structural dynamics, vibration isolation, resonance management, thermal drift, backlash, friction, cable drag and other practical effects influencing precision control.


 General Requirements
   

  

* Ability to work in a mission\-focused, operational environment.
* Ability to think critically and make independent engineering decisions.
* Interpersonal skills to work in a diverse and dynamic cross\-functional team.
* Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
* Write and deliver technical documents, simulation reports and briefings.
* Good verbal and written communication skills as well as organizational skills.
* Travel occasionally as necessary for integration, field testing and deployment.

title: Inbound BDR — AI-Native Qualifier
description:
FlytBase


Every Fortune 500 deal starts with one conversation \- you'll learn to own it. Master the art of qualifying fast, asking the right questions, and deciding what's real \- with real ownership from day one.


Business Development
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Full\-time
 Freshers
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett. FlytBase has its presence in 70\+ countries with offices in the US and Pune, India. FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. We operate at AI speed \- autonomy and intelligence at our core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


You are the first human touchpoint for every inbound lead that flows into FlytBase. A mining executive downloads our white paper. A facilities manager books a demo. A partner forwards a warm intro. They all land with you first—and it's your job to figure out what happens next. This isn't script\-reading or box\-checking. You'll learn to research accounts, ask sharp questions, and make real judgment calls: Is this a sales\-ready opportunity for our AE team? Does it need more nurturing? Should it be routed to a regional partner? You'll own that decision—with coaching and AI tools to help you get faster and smarter every week. You'll talk to people running energy grids, mining operations, and critical infrastructure. They're exploring autonomous drone systems for the first time. Your job is to understand their world quickly, send the right materials, and qualify intelligently. This is where you learn enterprise sales from the ground up—at a company building Physical AI for mission\-critical operations across 300\+ sites in 40\+ countries.
### **What You'll Own**


• Qualifying every inbound lead within 24 hours—research the account, understand the use case, decide the next step • Running discovery calls to understand prospect needs, technical fit, and buying timeline • Routing sales\-ready opportunities to AEs with a clear handoff brief—context, pain points, urgency • Nurturing early\-stage leads through follow\-ups, content sharing, and staying top\-of\-mind until they're ready • Managing regional partner referrals—deciding when to loop in partners vs. handling direct • Building and maintaining your lead database in HubSpot—every interaction logged, every status updated • Using AI tools to research prospects, draft emails, summarize calls, and move faster than humanly possible • Flagging patterns: What campaigns are generating high\-intent leads? What verticals are heating up? • Collaborating with marketing to improve lead quality and refine messaging based on what you hear daily • Learning fast: You'll shadow AE calls, get coached on objections, and level up your enterprise sales IQ every week
### **Best Suited For**


• Freshers who want to build a career in enterprise B2B sales—not just any sales job • Fast learners who can research an unfamiliar industry (mining, energy, logistics) and sound credible in 48 hours • People who are energized by talking to senior executives and asking smart questions, not intimidated by it • Natural curiosity about technology—you want to understand what autonomous drones actually do and why enterprises buy them • Strong written and verbal communication in English—your emails and call notes represent FlytBase • Comfort with AI tools—you'll use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Apollo, and workflows we've built to 10x your output • Self\-starters who don't wait to be told what to do—if a lead goes cold, you figure out how to re\-engage • Coachability—you take feedback, iterate fast, and don't take rejection personally
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• Ownership without hand\-holding: You won't have a checklist for every scenario. You'll make calls, own outcomes, and learn from mistakes fast. • Resourcefulness over experience: You'd rather Google, research, and figure it out than wait for someone to explain it to you. • Bias for action: You'd rather send an imperfect email today than a perfect one next week. Speed matters. • Hunger to learn enterprise sales: You see this as the foundation of a sales career, not a stepping stone to escape as fast as possible. • High candor: You give honest feedback on what's working and what's not—no corporate BS, no silent frustration. • Competitive energy: You track your metrics, want to be the best qualifier on the team, and care about winning deals (even if you don't close them yourself).
### **What We Don't Want**


• People who see BDR work as beneath them or a checkbox role to 'get through' before real sales starts • Candidates who expect to be spoon\-fed scripts, templates, and step\-by\-step instructions for every interaction • Anyone who thinks talking to prospects is uncomfortable or draining—this role is 80% communication • Low\-agency thinkers who wait for someone to tell them a lead is dead instead of figuring it out themselves • People who measure effort by hours logged, not outcomes created—busy doesn't mean effective • Candidates allergic to feedback or who take coaching as criticism rather than growth fuel
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Who You'll Work With**


You'll report to the Sales Lead and work closely with AEs who will coach you on enterprise deal cycles. You'll also collaborate daily with the marketing team to improve lead quality and share what's actually happening in prospect conversations.
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you want to learn enterprise sales at a company building the future of autonomous operations—and you're ready to own outcomes from day one—let's talk.

title: Interior Designer
description:

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Interior Designer** to join our design team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating innovative interior design concepts, preparing detailed drawings, coordinating with clients and project teams, and ensuring smooth execution of projects. The role requires strong design visualization skills, proficiency in AutoCAD, and the ability to translate client requirements into functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces.

* Review the test cases to check 100% coverage of customer requirements

title: Associate- Enterprise Technology CoE (ET)
description:
**ABOUT US:**





 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 
 





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:** 






 This role is based in the Enterprise Technology Center of Excellence (ET CoE), part of Bain’s broader “Data \& Technology” umbrella within the BCN. The Enterprise Technology CoE provides specialized support on Tech Strategy, Transformation, and Roadmap projects for Bain clients across industries. The HR Executive is expected to build a disciplined, customer\-focused, and high\-performing workforce.

KPI

* Payroll inputs submitted accurately and on time every month.

4\. Employee Relations

* Address employee concerns and grievances.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one discussions with staff.

* Organize employee engagement activities.

KPI

* Employee satisfaction score.
* Reduced employee turnover.

5\. Performance Management

* Coordinate probation reviews.
* Track KPIs for each department.
* Assist managers during performance evaluations.
* Recommend training and development plans.

KPI

* 100% probation reviews completed on schedule.

6\. Training \& Development

* Conduct induction and refresher training.
* Organize customer service, hygiene, and grooming sessions.
* Maintain employee training records.

KPI

* Minimum 4 training sessions per month.
* 100% staff trained on SOPs.

7\. HR Compliance

* Maintain employee files and statutory records.
* Support compliance with labour laws and company policies.

KPI

* Zero compliance issues due to missing HR documentation.

8\. Employee Retention

* Conduct stay interviews with new hires during their first 30, 60, and 90 days.
* Conduct exit interviews.
* Identify reasons for employee turnover.
* Recommend retention initiatives.

KPI

* Maintain annual employee retention targets.
* Reduce early attrition (within first 90 days).

Daily Responsibilities

* Review attendance and staffing levels.
* Meet department heads regarding manpower needs.
* Conduct interviews and onboarding activities.
* Resolve employee concerns.
* Update HR records.
* Monitor grooming and uniform compliance.
* Prepare daily HR status report for the General Manager.

Skills

* Recruitment and interviewing

* Payroll coordination

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution
* Ability to maintain confidentiality

Working Hours

HR Executive → Senior HR Executive → HR Manager → Cluster HR Manager

At Pentoz, the HR Executive is not just an administrator. They are responsible for building a service\-oriented culture.

Key focus areas include:

* Hiring employees with the right attitude, not just experience.
* Reducing staff turnover, especially during the first 90 days.
* Ensuring every employee understands Pentoz’s service standards.

This role is central to creating a stable workforce that delivers consistent guest experiences and supports Pentoz’s long\-term growth.

The **Founder's Office** sits at the center of the organization.

As a Founder's Office Intern, you won't be limited to one department or one function. Instead, you'll work directly with the Founders on strategic priorities while gaining exposure across business development, operations, finance, recruitment, execution, and organizational management.

Every week will be different.

Some days you'll be preparing investor or partnership material. Some days you'll coordinate hiring, improve internal processes, analyze competitors, manage operations, or support leadership in executing high\-priority initiatives.

This is a high\-ownership role designed for candidates who want to accelerate their learning curve and understand what it takes to build and scale a technology startup.

* Exceptional communication skills.

**What You'll Gain**

This internship is designed to provide practical startup experience—not observational work.

You'll receive:

* Paid Internship (As per Company Norms)

* Exposure to startup strategy, business development, operations, recruitment, finance, and leadership.

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* Take ownership without waiting for instructions.

* Are comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Enjoy solving business problems.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Company:** Avylin Consultancy  
**Location:** Dubai, India, Thailand  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary Range:** INR 600000 \- INR 1000000 per year

**Avylin Consultancy — About Us**

Avylin Consultancy is a fast\-growing consultancy built on a simple premise: great advice shouldn't be confined to one market. Since our founding, we've expanded steadily across three key regions — Dubai, Thailand, and India — bringing together local market knowledge and international standards of delivery.

Our client base spans industries and geographies, but the approach stays consistent: understand the business first, then design solutions that actually fit — not generic frameworks forced onto unique problems. Being present across the Middle East and South and Southeast Asia lets us spot patterns and opportunities that a single\-market firm would miss, and gives our clients access to a broader network of expertise wherever they operate.

As we continue to grow, our focus remains on building long\-term partnerships with the businesses we serve, backed by the kind of hands\-on, responsive support that got us here in the first place.

**The Role**

We are seeking a talented Full\-Stack Developer with ideally 1 to 2 years (freshers are welcome as well from IIT, NIT or IIITs) of professional experience. While you may be early in your career, we expect a high level of technical rigor. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying end\-to\-end features. You will work across the entire stack, from building responsive user interfaces to designing robust backend APIs and database schemas.

Because we are building complex systems, we require candidates who possess strong problem\-solving skills, a deep understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), and the ability to think critically about System Design.

Key Responsibilities

* **Full\-Stack Development:** Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable web applications using modern frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js, Python/Django, or similar).
* **System Architecture:** Participate in early\-stage system design discussions. Build scalable, maintainable, and efficient backend services and APIs.
* **Problem Solving:** Apply advanced data structures and algorithms to solve complex business and technical challenges efficiently.
* **Code Quality:** Write clean, modular, and well\-documented code. Participate in rigorous code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with founders, product managers, and other engineers to define feature specifications and deliver product milestones.
* **Performance Optimization:** Identify bottlenecks, optimize application performance, and ensure high availability of our systems.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Freshers are welcome (IIT, IIIT, NIT). Good to have 2\+ years experience
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* **Core Engineering Skills:** Exceptional grasp of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). You should be comfortable solving complex algorithmic problems efficiently.
* **System Design:** Foundational understanding of system design principles, distributed systems, database modeling, and API design.
* **Frontend Technologies:** Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular).
* **Backend Technologies:** Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Node.js, Java, Go, or C\#) and experience with RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* **Databases:** Experience with relational (SQL) and non\-relational (NoSQL) databases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an early\-stage startup environment.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

**Our Interview Process**

We hold our engineering team to the highest standards. Our interview process is rigorous, modeled after top\-tier tech companies, and is designed to thoroughly evaluate your technical depth and problem\-solving abilities. The process consists of 8 to 9 rounds:

* **Initial Recruiter Screen (30 mins):** Discuss your background, experience, and alignment with our startup's mission.
* **Technical Phone Screen (45 mins):** Basic coding and algorithmic problem\-solving.
* **Coding Round 1 \- Data Structures \& Algorithms (45 mins):** Focus on arrays, strings, and hash maps.
* **Coding Round 2 \- Advanced DSA (45 mins):** Focus on trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and recursion.
* **Coding Round 3 \- Practical Application (45 mins):** Machine coding or building a small functional component/API from scratch.
* **System Design \- Fundamentals (45 mins):** High\-level architecture, database schema design, and API design for a scalable system.
* **System Design \- Deep Dive (45 mins):** Scaling, load balancing, caching strategies, and handling bottlenecks.
* **Behavioral \& Culture Fit (45 mins):** Discuss past experiences, conflict resolution, and adaptability in a startup environment.
* **Founder Interview (30 mins):** Final conversation regarding vision, equity, and mutual expectations.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Impact:** As an early engineer, your work will directly shape the product and company trajectory.
* **Growth:** Work alongside experienced founders and tackle complex engineering problems daily.
* **Compensation:** Competitive startup base salary combined with meaningful equity.
* **Flexibility:** Flexible working hours and remote\-friendly culture.

*If you are a passionate builder who loves tackling hard technical problems and wants to be part of a high\-growth consultancy working with startups, we encourage you to apply.*

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Description: Head of HR \& Operations ComplianceRole Overview
 
 We are seeking a high\-caliber, trilingual
 **Head of HR \& Operations Compliance** 
 to build, train, and lead an administrative and operational support team. This unique role sits at the intersection of human resource management, factory efficiency, and corporate affairs.
 



 You will not only manage a multi\-collar workforce but will also oversee team members dedicated to monitoring production efficiency, tracking preventive machine maintenance, and aggressively driving state and central government compliance, licensing, and subsidy applications.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Team Building \& Leadership
 * **Structure the Department:** 
 Hire, train, and manage a lean, high\-performing team divided into specialized tracks: Workforce Training/KPIs, Technical/Maintenance Tracking, and Government Relations/Liaison.
* **Delegation \& Accountability:** 
 Set clear performance metrics for your team to ensure zero delays in paperwork, vendor follow\-ups, or compliance cycles.


 2\. Workforce Training \& Production Efficiency Tracking
 * **Labor Training Programs:** 
 Design and implement structured training modules for skilled and unskilled labor to ensure safety, quality control, and minimized wastage.
* **Efficiency Analytics:** 
 Oversee the tracking of daily, weekly, and monthly Labour Efficiency (OLE) and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* **Team Dynamics:** 
 Monitor team\-wise output across shifts and implement incentive or corrective frameworks to optimize production baselines.


 3\. Asset Management, Maintenance \& Vendor Relations
 * **Upkeep Tracking:** 
 Implement and oversee a rigorous preventive maintenance schedule for all plant machinery to minimize downtime.
* **Vendor Follow\-ups:** 
 Act as the primary escalation point for equipment vendors, engineering contractors, and service providers, ensuring AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) guidelines are strictly met.


 4\. Compliance Cycles, Government Liaison \& Subsidies
 * **End\-to\-End Compliance:** 
 Map out and own all compliance calendars (Pollution Control Board, Factories Act, Labor Welfare, Industrial Safety, etc.).
* **On\-the\-Field Bureaucracy:** 
 Personally lead or direct team members to visit regional government offices, clear bureaucratic bottlenecks, and secure necessary approvals.
* **Subsidy \& Grant Management:** 
 Research, prepare flawless applications for, and follow up on central and state\-level industrial/agricultural/export subsidies and incentive schemes.


 Job Requirements \& Qualifications
 **Language Proficiency (Mandatory)** 
* **Tamil:** 
 Native or bilingual fluency (critical for local factory operations, ground labor coordination, and regional state government offices).
* **Hindi:** 
 Fluent (essential for out\-of\-state workforce management and interactions with national technical vendors).
* **English:** 
 Professional business proficiency (essential for high\-level legal documentation, central subsidy applications, and executive reporting).


**Experience \& Core Competencies** 
* **Experience:** 
 8 to 12\+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally combining Plant HR, Industrial Relations (IR), and Factory Administration.
* **Government Liaising Track Record:** 
 Documented success in dealing with Indian government departments, securing industrial licenses, and successfully reclaiming subsidies.
* **Systems\-Driven:** 
 Experience using or implementing production tracking, asset management, or ERP software (e.g., automated maintenance logs, HRMS).

 Red Fort Capital is seeking a dependable and well\-organized Office Manager \& HR Coordinator to manage the day\-to\-day administration of its BKC office and coordinate routine HR activities.  I.
 
 Office Administration
 





 · Manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the office and ensure workspaces, meeting rooms and common areas remain organized and professional.
 





 · Maintain office supplies, stationery, pantry items, equipment and inventory.
 





 · Coordinate housekeeping, office assistants, drivers, IT support, couriers and other vendors.
 





 · Manage repairs, maintenance, internet, telephone and office\-equipment servicing.
 





 · Coordinate with the landlord and building management.
 





 · Maintain office asset, access\-card, key and inventory records.

 II.
 

 HR Administration

 III. Recruitment Coordinator

 · Follow up on selected administrative matters.

 · Experience in an NBFC, financial\-services company, professional\-services firm or growing company is preferred.
 





 · Experience in a fast\-paced or entrepreneurial environment is an advantage.

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer
   

  

* About the role


 Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.
   

  

 For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.
   

  

 We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.
   

  

 The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.
   

  

 You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.
   

  

* What you'll do


**Watch, and know what you're looking at.** 
 Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.
   

  

**Troubleshoot and resolve.** 
 This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.
   

  

**Keep the network healthy, not just alive.** 
 A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.
   

  

**Build and automate.** 
 The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.
   

  

**Move the work forward.** 
 You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.
   

  

**Report exactly what is happening.** 
 For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.
   

  

**Escalate well.** 
 Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.
   

  

* Who we're looking for


 A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.
   

  

 Must\-have
   

  

* Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.
* Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.
* Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.
* Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.
* Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.
* Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.
* Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.
* Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.
* Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.


 Nice\-to\-have
   

  

* CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.
* Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.
* Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi\-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.
* Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).
* Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).
* Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.
* Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.
* Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.
* IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).
* What we offer
* A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.
* A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026\. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.
* Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.
* Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.
* A team that writes things down, runs on runbooks and post mortems rather than blame, and treats operational discipline as the job, not the paperwork around it.

title: Technical Customer Support Professional
description:
**Shape the Future of Connected Systems as a TechOps Engineer**
 Are you a highly skilled technical professional ready to bridge the gap between complex software solutions and seamless operations? As a TechOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the successful implementation and deployment of Application solutions on hosted and on\-premise customer servers. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you will provide critical technical expertise, troubleshooting assistance, and vital user support during the deployment process.
   

  

**About Us**
 Trimble is transforming the way the world works by delivering products and services that connect the physical and digital worlds. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics enable customers to improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability. From purpose\-built products to enterprise lifecycle solutions, Trimble software, hardware, and services are transforming a broad range of industries such as agriculture, construction, geospatial and transportation, and logistics.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 In this role, you will have a massive impact by owning the success of infrastructure deployments and system rollouts for our global clients. You will blend cloud\-based platform orchestration with hands\-on systems engineering, giving you full technical autonomy across diverse server environments. You will interface directly with stakeholders, product teams, and end\-users, quickly becoming the ultimate product expert while driving automation and optimization strategies across our deployment pipeline.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Deployment Planning \& Coordination: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to design deployment strategies, manage timelines, map resource requirements, and ensure flawless execution of deployment plans.
* Technical Architecture \& Guidance: Act as the subject matter expert on deployed systems or software, identifying technical challenges or risks, and proactively proposing resilient solutions or workarounds.
* User Support \& Training: Assist end\-users in understanding and utilizing deployed systems, deliver training sessions to familiarize users with new functionalities, and address queries with timely resolutions.
* Documentation \& Progress Tracking: Create and maintain comprehensive deployment documentation (procedures, user guides, troubleshooting resources), prepare progress reports for stakeholders, and track deployment\-related risks.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize the deployment process, propose and implement process improvements or tools, and stay updated with industry trends and best practices related to deployment methodologies.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with proven experience in deployment support, software implementation, or a similar role.
* Cloud Platform Mastery: Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar providers) across core services including compute, storage, networking, databases, and secure deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
* Systems Administration \& Networking: Proficient in server provisioning, configuration management, troubleshooting, and virtualization technologies (VMWare, Hyper\-V, KVM). Deep knowledge of networking concepts such as IP addressing, subnets, routing, load balancing, and firewalls in cloud environments.
* Cloud Security Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network security groups, and data protection.
* Professional Competence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, active listening capabilities, a highly organized and self\-directed approach to problem\-solving, and the ability to maintain accuracy and quality under tight schedules.


**Bonus Points For**
* Automation Capabilities: High proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation.
* Cross\-Functional Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Business Accounting (analyzing financial statements, invoice processing in accounts payable/receivable) and basics of Payroll Management.
* Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly develop and maintain a high level of knowledge of Viewpoint software products and remain an expert from both an internal and user perspective.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Demonstrated ability to empathize with customers, handle sensitive records with discretion, and defuse challenging situations with professionalism and good judgment.


**Logistics**
* Location: India \- Chennai (In Office)
* Job Type: Full\-Time


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
   

  

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
   

  

 Candidate Privacy Notices by Country
   

  

 If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: AI Developer
description:
Thought Pilot · Hyderabad (In\-office, full\-time) · ₹6\-7 LPA
 



  





 About us
 



  





 Thought Pilot runs the content engine for B2B founders and executives (SaaS CEOs, GTM leaders) across X and LinkedIn. Under the hood it's not a "social media agency" — it's an AI system: Claude\-powered writers, automated data pipelines, and a steady stream of small tools and microsites we ship for clients. You'll work directly with the founder on the machine that makes it all run.
 



  





 What you'll own
 


* Feed the system. Our content agent runs on a constant diet of fresh client data (posts, transcripts, analytics, research). Some sources flow in automatically; some are still painful manual uploads. Your job is both to keep the data flowing 
 *and* 
  to build the connectors that kill the manual work for good.
* Ship lead magnets. We ship 4\-5 lead magnets a week: small repos, microsites, dashboards, and interactive tools deployed on Vercel. You'll be the production line that turns an idea into a live, polished thing by end of week, every week.
* Test and optimize models. We run a lot of AI generations. You'll build a simple eval harness to test different models (Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku and others) on real tasks and tell us which gives the best quality per rupee, then keep that honest over time.



 You're a fit if you
 


* Build fast with AI tools. You already use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar to ship real things, not just toy demos.
* Are comfortable in Python for glue/automation and can stand up a clean frontend \+ deploy it (Vercel/Next.js or similar).
* Can work in a messy, existing codebase without needing everything documented first.
* Have a shipper's instinct: you'd rather have something live and iterating than perfect and unshipped.
* Communicate clearly and self\-direct. This is in\-office and hands\-on, but nobody will micromanage your task list.



 Nice to have (not required)
 


* Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or agent/MCP tooling.
* Familiarity with APIs like Notion, social platforms, or scraping/ingestion pipelines.
* A CS degree is welcome but not the filter. Show us what you've built.



 Details
 


* Full\-time, in\-office in Hyderabad.
* ₹6\-7 LPA depending on what you can demonstrably do.
* Direct mentorship from the founder and daily exposure to production AI systems.



 How to apply
 



 Don't send a generic resume. Send us:
 


1. One thing you've built with AI tools (link to a repo, live site, or demo).
2. Two lines on how you'd approach a source that's currently "manual upload only" and make it automatic.



 Applicants who complete a short paid trial task (build one lead magnet \+ wire one data source in a week) get priority.

title: Associate- PEG (AI Solutions Engineer)
description:
**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 





  
 





**Who you will work with** 






 BCN PEG CoE provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations – 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner and bringing deep technical expertise.
 





  
 





**What you’ll do** 






 As an Associate (Tech) at BCN PEG, you will bring specialized technical knowledge to product development of internal tools as well as help in end client delivery of cases. You will:
 



* Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered applications using LLMs (especially OpenAI Models) and related technologies
* Implement python\-based API integrations with LLM platforms to enable use cases such as summarization, classification, extraction, reasoning, and workflow automation
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and reusable prompt frameworks to ensure reliability, accuracy, and scalability of AI outputs
* Build AI agents and tools that orchestrate multi\-step workflows, tool calling, and interaction with structured and unstructured data sources
* Collaborate with consultants and case teams to translate business problems into practical AI solutions
* Evaluate and experiment with emerging AI frameworks, libraries, and tools for potential adoption
* Support supervisors in work planning, solution design, and brainstorming for AI initiatives
* Ensure solutions are robust, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with Bain’s engineering and governance standards
* Communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Proactively drive self\-learning in AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community




**About you** 






**Must\-have skills:** 




* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic, including prompt design and response handling
* Experience building AI agents, workflows, or automation tools using LLMs
* Ability to build evaluation sets, guardrails, and regression checks to measure, monitor, and safeguard the quality and reliability of LLM outputs
* Understanding of context engineering techniques, limitations of LLMs, and methods to improve output quality
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services
* Working knowledge of data structures, basic algorithms, and software engineering best practices
* Experience using version control systems such as Git
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving requirements
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly




**Good\-to\-have skills:** 




* Experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Exposure to vector databases and embeddings (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma)
* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and NLP
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies such as Angular, React and HTMX
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience building internal tools, prototypes, or dashboards
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and usage guides




**Educational qualification \& Professional experience** 




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability, and problem\-solving skills
* Work experience range: Undergraduate degree: 2 \- 4 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, or related roles
* Postgraduate degree: 0 \- 2 years of relevant experience
* Prior exposure to consulting, analytics, or business problem\-solving environments is preferred but not mandatory







  




**What makes us a great place to work** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Agentic AI Implementation / Customer Success Engineer - Night Shift
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.
   

  

 At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.
   

  

 Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.
   

  

 If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.
   

  

**Work Hours:** 
 Night Shift (7:00 PM \- 3:00 AM IST)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**In\-Office Expectation:** 
 This role is primarily shift\-based. As the office does not currently operate between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM, work during these hours will be performed remotely until further notice. The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to modify office operating hours and require in\-office work in the future.
   

  

 Employees may be required to work onsite on an occasional basis for team collaboration, meetings, or other business needs. Accordingly, candidates must be based in Bengaluru and maintain the ability to work from Nextiva’s office located at Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, as required.
   

  

 Specific work schedules and any flexibility will be determined by the employee’s reporting manager in alignment with business requirements and team collaboration needs.
   

  

 This role serves as a growth path into AI Solutions Engineering, Product Specialist opportunities, or Customer Success Leadership. At Nextiva, all team members working a standard shift are expected to work onsite, supporting a highly collaborative, in\-person team environment.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Nextiva is looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented
 **AI Implementation / Customer Success Engineer** 
 to help deploy AI solutions for customers, design high\-quality conversational experiences, and manage end\-to\-end agent implementations. This role blends technical skills, prompt engineering, workflow design, and customer\-facing responsibilities to ensure successful delivery of AI\-driven customer experience products.
   

  

 You will work closely with product, engineering, and customer success teams to translate business needs into scalable AI workflows and optimized conversational agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Agent Implementation \& Prompt Engineering
   

  

* Design, build, and optimize AI agents using advanced prompt engineering techniques.
* Create structured workflows and decision trees that guide AI agent behavior.
* Use LLMs such as GPT\-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llama etc., to build, test, and refine agents.
* Implement function\-calling / tool\-calling capability within prompts using simple UI builders.
* Configure constraints and guardrails to reduce hallucinations and ensure reliable outputs.


 Customer\-Facing Implementation
   

  

* Work directly with customers to understand business needs, use cases, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into technical implementation plans.
* Assist in onboarding, deployment, and testing of AI solutions for customer environments.
* Provide ongoing optimization and support to ensure solution adoption and success.


 Workflow \& Integration Management
   

  

* Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using platform workflow builders.
* Integrate agents with customer tools, APIs, CRMs, or communication platforms where needed.
* Troubleshoot workflow, configuration, or data issues during implementation.


 Conversation \& Experience Design
   

  

* Create high\-quality conversation flows for AI agents, ensuring clarity, tone, and brand alignment.
* Apply AI conversation design principles to improve user satisfaction and agent performance.


 Technical Skills \& Development
   

  

* Use basic Python for data handling, API interactions, testing, or workflow extensions.
* Work with GenAI technologies, SaaS tools, and no\-code/low\-code integration platforms.
* Perform evaluation and tuning of AI prompts, workflows, and agent performance.


 Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Documentation
   

  

* Work with product teams to relay customer feedback and improve platform features.
* Maintain clear documentation for workflows, prompts, integrations, and customer implementations.
* Train customers and internal teams on product capabilities and best practices


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 1\+ years of experience in AI product implementation, customer success engineering, or technical support roles.
* Prior experience supporting US based customers strongly preferred
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to clearly explain technical and AI\-driven processes to non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable leading customer discussions, gathering requirements, and explaining issues, solutions, and next steps with clarity and confidence.
* Strong hands\-on experience with LLMs (GPT\-4o, Gemini, Claude, etc.) for building agents and prompts.
* Solid understanding of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and workflow design.
* Basic knowledge of Python, APIs, and SaaS tools.
* Experience in customer support / onboarding / technical implementation.
* Ability to manage hallucinations, constraints, and safe AI output design.
* Experience with workflow builders and no\-code automation platforms.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Willingness to work night shifts to collaborate with global teams or customers.


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have) Skills**
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or RAG workflows.
* Experience with API\-based integrations.
* Familiarity with enterprise customer environments (CRM, CX platforms, VoIP, ticketing tools).
* Understanding of AI evaluation frameworks (test cases, scoring, prompt iteration).
* Exposure to Nextiva products or any communication/CX platforms is a plus.


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge GenAI implementations for global customers.
* Growth path into AI Solutions Engineering, Product Specialist, or Customer Success Leadership roles.
* Collaborative global team environment with high ownership and autonomy.


**Nextiva DNA** 
 (Core Competencies)
   

  

 Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:
   

  

* Drives Results: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* Critical Thinker: Data\-driven, forward\-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work.
* Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.


**Total Rewards**
 Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.
   

  

 Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.
   

  

* Medical 🩺 \- Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500,000 INR, as well as their parents or in\-laws for up to 300,000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity.
* Group Term \& Group Personal Accident Insurance 💼 \- Provides insurance coverage against the risk of death / injury during the policy period sustained due to an accident caused by violent, visible \& external means.
+ Coverage Type \- Employee Only
+ Sum Insured \- 3 times of annual CTC with minimum cap of INR 10,00,000
+ Free Cover Limit \- 1\.5 Crore

* Work\-Life Balance ⚖️ \- 15 days of Privilege leaves per calendar year, 6 days of Paid Sick leave per calendar year, 6 days of Casual leave per calendar year. Paid 26 weeks of Maternity leaves, 1 week of Paternity leave, a day off on your Birthday, and paid holidays
* Financial Security💰 \- Provident Fund \& Gratuity
* Wellness 🤸‍ \- Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives

**Company:** 
 OnMeta ·
 **Location:**

 Full\-time
 



**About OnMeta** 




 OnMeta was India's first B2B crypto on\-ramp. We build compliant, plug\-and\-play fiat on/off\-ramps that let users buy and sell digital assets with local payment methods like UPI — settling in under 60 seconds. We're FIU\-registered, power 80\+ web3 companies (Ledger, Delta Exchange, Sushi), and ship a widget, a JSON API, and a React Native SDK that partners embed in their own apps. Founded by two ex\-Rapido operators who scaled one of India's biggest mobility stacks.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Build wallet and payment flows in React Native — for our own surfaces and the
 **SDK that 80\+ partners embed** 
 , where your code runs inside apps you don't control.
* Own the states most apps get wrong: amount validation, async balance/quote loading, retries, and error handling that never loses what the user typed — all before money moves.
* Turn financial flows (top\-ups, balances, fees, limits, KYC) into interfaces that are impossible to misread on any device.
* Partner with backend, product, and compliance to keep on/off\-ramp UX fast and trustworthy across India and Southeast Asia.



**You're a fit if you** 



* Have shipped production React Native (or strong React) and think in components, state, and edge cases.
* Sweat the details: what happens on a failed request, a slow load, an invalid amount, a flaky bank API.
* Write clean, testable code and can reason about currency/precision without hand\-waving.
* Care about fintech\-grade correctness — when you're a payment rail for other companies, user trust is the product.



**Nice to have** 



* Payments, wallets, crypto on/off\-ramps, or SDK/library engineering.
* Testing with @testing\-library/react\-native; experience shipping npm packages consumed by third parties.
