title: Application Consultant-Edge & Network Cloud
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant specializing in Edge \& Network Cloud, you will utilize your applied knowledge of fundamental concepts and technologies associated with Telecom Network, Software Defined Network/NFV to deliver solutions. You will perform consulting, requirement gathering, and implementation tasks to drive business outcomes. Your primary responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Perform Consulting Services: Deliver expert advice and guidance to clients on the implementation and configuration of ALM, ASM, and various virtual network functions from NEPs.
* Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and create High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) documents.
* Implement and Configure Solutions: Apply technical expertise to implement and configure ALM, ASM, and other solutions, ensuring seamless integration with existing OSS systems.
* Integrate with OSS Systems: Work on integrating ALM, ASM, NOI with other OSS systems, depending on the solution scope, to ensure a cohesive and efficient system.
* Solution Delivery: Support the delivery of solutions, leveraging Agile methodologies and lifecycle management best practices.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Telecom Network Fundamentals: Exposure to fundamental concepts and technologies associated with Telecom Network, including Software Defined Network and NFV.
* Consulting and Requirement Gathering: Experience working with stakeholders to gather requirements and create High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) documents.
* ALM and ASM Implementation: Exposure to implementing and configuring ALM (Agile life cycle manager) and ASM, with knowledge of integrating these systems with other OSS systems.
* Virtual Network Functions: Familiarity with various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) and their implementation in telecom networks.
* OSS System Integration: Experience working with the integration of ALM, ASM, NOI with other OSS systems, depending on the solution scope.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Telecom Network Architecture: Exposure to designing and implementing telecom network architectures, including Software Defined Network and NFV, to support solution delivery.
* Advanced ALM and ASM: Experience with advanced implementation and configuration of ALM and ASM, including integration with other OSS systems.
* Virtual Network Functionality: Familiarity with implementing and configuring various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) in telecom networks.

title: Associate - PEG (Full Stack Developer)
description:
**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 





  
 





**Who you will work with** 






 BCN PEG CoE provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations – 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner and bringing deep technical expertise.
 





  
 





**What you’ll do** 






 As an Associate (Tech) at BCN PEG, you will bring specialized technical knowledge to the product development of internal tools, as well as help in end\-client delivery of cases. You will:
 



* Design, build, and maintain responsive, user\-friendly web applications with a strong focus on front\-end development
* Develop modern, interactive front\-end interfaces using React (with Vite), Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion to deliver polished, performant, and animated user experiences
* Build and integrate Node.js back\-end services and APIs, including the ability to stand up a simple Node.js application independently from scratch
* Translate design mockups and business requirements into clean, maintainable, and reusable components
* Collaborate with consultants and case teams to translate business problems into practical web applications
* Evaluate and experiment with emerging front\-end frameworks, libraries, and tools for potential adoption
* Support supervisors in work planning, solution design, and brainstorming for product initiatives
* Ensure applications are robust, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with Bain’s engineering and governance standards
* Communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Proactively drive self\-learning in modern web development and emerging front\-end technologies
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community







  




**About you** 






**Must\-have skills:** 




* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience building front\-end applications with React, using Vite as the build tool
* Proficiency with Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for animation and interaction design
* Strong understanding of modern front\-end architecture, component design, and responsive UI principles
* Working knowledge of Node.js, with the ability to build a simple Node.js application independently from scratch
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services
* Working knowledge of data structures, basic algorithms, and software engineering best practices
* Experience using version control systems such as Git
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving requirements
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly




**Good\-to\-have skills:** 




* Familiarity with other front\-end frameworks such as Vue, Svelte, or Angular
* Some background in Python
* Basic awareness of AI and LLM\-based tools and APIs
* Basic understanding of application deployment and hosting workflows
* Knowledge of relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
* Experience building internal tools, prototypes, or dashboards
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and usage guides




**Educational qualification \& Professional experience** 




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability, and problem\-solving skills
* Work experience range: Undergraduate degree: 2 \- 4 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, or related roles
* Postgraduate degree: 0 \- 2 years of relevant experience
* Prior exposure to consulting, analytics, or business problem\-solving environments is preferred but not mandatory







  




**What makes us a great place to work** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Frontend Developer (Shopify)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Healthfab® is a fast\-growing startup focused on delivering innovative and affordable health and hygiene solutions. Its flagship product, GoPadFree, is a leak\-proof, reusable cotton period panty that has become a popular choice among consumers. Supported by leading investors and advanced manufacturing capabilities, Healthfab® is positioned to transform the menstrual hygiene category. The company is committed to offering safe, comfortable, and eco\-friendly alternatives that improve everyday life and promote sustainability. Team members can contribute to meaningful products that have a direct positive impact on users’ well\-being.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Shopify Frontend Developer who lives and breathes
 **theme customization** 
 . You'll own the look, feel, and performance of our Shopify storefront — building pixel\-perfect pages, Storefron experience. This is a hands\-on, high\-velocity role for someone who can take a design or a rough idea and turn it into a live, conversion\-friendly page the same week.
 



 If you love working in a rapid environment where your work goes live quickly and directly impacts revenue, this is for you.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Customize and maintain our Shopify theme using
 **Liquid** 
 , HTML, CSS/SCSS, and JavaScript.
* Build and launch landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and campaign pages — often on tight timelines.
* Translate designs (Figma) into responsive, pixel\-perfect, cross\-browser\-compatible pages.
* Rapidly iterate on the storefront to support marketing pushes, sales, product launches, and A/B tests.
* Optimize page speed and Core Web Vitals to improve load times and conversion.
* Configure and customize Shopify sections, blocks, and theme settings so non\-technical teammates can update content easily.
* Integrate and configure Shopify apps (reviews, upsells, subscriptions, page builders, analytics).
* Ensure the storefront is accessible, mobile\-first, and consistent with our brand.
* Debug frontend and theme issues quickly and keep the store running smoothly.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience with
 **Shopify theme development and customization** 
 .
* Strong proficiency in
 **Shopify Liquid** 
 .
* Excellent command of HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Solid understanding of responsive, mobile\-first design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Experience building custom, reusable Shopify sections and blocks with theme settings.
* Ability to translate Figma / design files into accurate, polished pages.
* Comfort working in a
 **fast\-paced, rapid\-turnaround environment** 
 with shifting priorities.
* Familiarity with Git and version\-controlled theme workflows.

**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with Shopify Online Store 2\.0, metafields, and metaobjects.

* Knowledge of SEO and conversion rate optimization (CRO) best practices.

**Why Join Healthfab** 



* Do meaningful work for a mission\-driven brand improving menstrual health for women across India.
* Ship fast and see your work go live to lakhs of customers within days.
* Work closely with the founding, design, and growth teams.



**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume, portfolio, and links to
 **live Shopify stores or themes you've built** 
 to

 with the subject line "Shopify Frontend Developer — \[Your Name]." A strong portfolio of storefront work matters more than a long resume.

description:
Job Title: HR Manager – Solar \& Infrastructure

Role Overview

The HR Manager will oversee the full employee lifecycle across both corporate headquarters and regional solar/infrastructure project sites. This role balances strategic talent acquisition for highly specialized engineering roles with the operational realities of managing industrial labor, statutory compliance, and rigorous health and safety (EHS) tracking in the field.

Key Responsibilities \& Duties

1\. Strategic Workforce Planning \& Mobilization

Partner with Project Directors to forecast labor demands based on project pipelines and commissioning schedules.

Rapidly mobilize and demobilize site\-specific teams as project phases transition from civil engineering to electrical installation.

Manage a robust pipeline of both permanent staff and contract\-based blueprint/technical labor.

2\. Specialized \& High\-Volume Recruitment

Corporate/Technical: Source and hire specialized talent including Solar Design Engineers, Grid Integration Experts, Contract Managers, and Project Directors.

Field Operations: Establish relationships with local labor contractors, trade schools, and industrial training institutes (ITIs) to secure site technicians, surveyors, and operators.

Manage local\-hiring mandates to maintain strong relationships with communities surrounding project sites.

3\. Statutory Compliance \& Labor Relations

Ensure strict compliance with all local, state, and central labor laws (including contract labor regulations, factory acts, and minimum wage mandates).

Oversee the management of labor accommodation (labor camps), ensuring they meet health, sanitation, and safety standards.

Mitigate labor disputes, manage union relations where applicable, and conduct regular grievance redressal audits on\-site.

4\. Safety (EHS) Integration \& Training

Collaborate closely with the Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) team to ensure 100% completion of mandatory safety inductions and continuous certifications (e.g., working at heights, electrical safety, heavy machinery operation).

Enforce zero\-tolerance policies regarding safety non\-compliance across all company locations.

5\. Payroll, Attendance \& Site Administration

Implement and manage robust attendance tracking systems (such as biometric or geo\-fenced mobile systems) capable of syncing data from remote locations to the central payroll system.

Ensure timely and accurate processing of site allowances, travel reimbursements, and overtime pay.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

Education: MBA or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, or a related field.

Experience: 5 to 8 years of proven HR experience, with at least 3 years specifically within the renewable energy, power, construction, or heavy infrastructure sectors.

Domain Expertise:

Deep understanding of regional labor laws and contract labor management.

Familiarity with tracking metrics across decentralized project sites.

Technical Savvy: Experience with modern HRIS/payroll platforms (e.g., Darwinbox, SuccessFactors, Zoho People) and remote attendance tools.

Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel to remote, off\-grid project site locations up to 30% of the time.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Time\-to\-Mobilize: Meeting headcount requirements for new project sites within the agreed\-upon pre\-construction timeline.

Compliance Score: Zero penalties or legal notices from government labor or safety boards during site inspections.

Retention Rate: Maintaining low attrition among critical technical staff (Project Engineers and Site Managers) during active project phases.

title: Associate AI / ML Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a motivated entry\-level engineer to join our team and help build Agentic AI applications, workflows, backend, and frontend utilizing machine learning and Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a fully on\-site position, and ideal for someone local who wants to kick\-start their career in AI, learn fast, and contribute to real\-world projects from day one. This role is challenging and fast\-paced, requiring someone who can absorb knowledge quickly, adapt to complex requirements, and execute at high speed. You'll be expected to prototype ideas within a couple of days to test feasibility, and contribute meaningfully to SaaS applications, ML pipelines, and LLM\-enabled features under the guidance of experienced engineers. If you are a recent graduate driven by curiosity, action\-oriented thinking, and a strong work ethic, this is a rare opportunity to accelerate your growth, work hands\-on with cutting\-edge AI technologies, and make a real impact from day one.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Build and test workflows and Agentic AI Applications
* Design and engineer SaaS applications and REST APIs
* Integrate open\-source LLMs and commercial APIs, into backend services using LangChain and other frameworks
* Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including embedding generation, vector store setup, and query orchestration
* Create and maintain prompt templates and toolchains for workflows like multi\-turn conversations or auto\-tagging of enterprise documents
* Write unit tests and debug issues in LLM\-powered features such as semantic search and summarization
* Prototype new ideas rapidly in 1\-2 days and iterate with feedback
* Document your work clearly and maintainably



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong Python and machine learning fundamentals
* Prior experience shipping code to production
* Experience with AI\-DLC processes and tools
* Design and engineering experience with SaaS products and REST APIs
* Hands\-on experience in building applications with LLMs like GPT, Claude, and LLaMA
* Understanding of embeddings, tokenization, and vector search
* Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks
* Comfortable with APIs, JSON, and CLI tools
* Ability to build middleware in Node.js and connect to Python backend
* Ability to work fast, prototype quickly, and accept feedback
* Self\-driven and persistent problem\-solver



  





**What We Offer** 




 A rare, hands\-on opportunity to learn real\-world AI/LLM development. Daily exposure to LLM models and tools.Direct mentorship from experienced engineers. Fast\-paced, execution\-focused culture. Performance\-based growth for driven candidates. Modest initial compensation with high learning ROI.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume and a brief note explaining your interest in AI/ML and why this opportunity excites you to careers@bitwiseacademy.com. If you have worked on any LLM projects \- GitHub links, demos, or code samples are strongly encouraged. As part of the interview process, you will be asked to implement a small prototype to demonstrate your ability to learn quickly, work independently, and apply AI/LLM concepts in code.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Machine Learning Engineer \- 1 with a strong understanding of the modern AI stack and the ability to contribute to production\-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate understands how LLMs work, can navigate a real codebase, and is comfortable using AI tools to accelerate their work without becoming dependent on them.
   

  

 You will be embedded directly in our engineering team and contribute to AI pipelines, APIs, and agent systems with guidance from senior ML engineers. Expect meaningful responsibility, thoughtful code reviews, and production exposure from day one.
   

  

**Role Requirements**
**LLM Fundamentals \& Prompting**
 Clear understanding of how LLMs work, including tokenization, context windows, temperature, structured output formatting, LLM guardrails, and hallucination prevention.
   

  

* Proficiency in prompting techniques such as few\-shot prompting, system prompts, structured outputs, role prompting, and reasoning\-oriented prompts.
* Familiarity with recent model releases, capability shifts, and architectural developments.
* Ability to run inference on local LLMs using tools like Ollama, VLLM, or Hugging Face Transformers


**AI Systems \& Engineering**
* Moderate to strong understanding of RAG architecture, including chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and generation.
* Working knowledge of AI agents, tool use, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or custom frameworks.
* Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI skills/tool design
* Transformer architecture basics — attention mechanism, encoder/decoder, positional encoding, embeddings
* Good foundation in neural networks, including core concepts such as layers, activation functions, loss functions, backpropagation, optimization, and model evaluation.


**Python \& Backend Engineering**
* Strong programming skills, especially in Python, including clean, idiomatic code, proper error handling, type hints, debugging, and the ability to build efficient algorithms for practical engineering problems.
* Ability to work with structured outputs: JSON schema, Pydantic models, data validation patterns
* Flask API development: REST endpoints, request/response handling, middleware
* Fundamental understanding of API scaling, including async and sync patterns and basic load considerations.
* Expert\-level Git operations: branching strategy, PR workflows, commit hygiene, rebasing/merging, resolving conflicts, and maintaining clean collaboration history.


**AI Tools \& Codebase Navigation**
* Ability to independently navigate an existing, non\-trivial codebase using AI\-assisted tools (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.)
* Uses AI tools to boost velocity — but can reason through code independently and does not require AI to explain every line


**Computer Vision \& Document AI (baseline knowledge required; expertise is not mandatory)**
* Rough working knowledge of image processing concepts: preprocessing, transformations, color spaces
* Familiarity with OCR tools and their practical limitations (Tesseract, Docling, AWS Textract, etc.).
* Basic awareness of object detection concepts (bounding boxes, YOLO\-style models)


**Communication \& Collaboration**
* Ability to articulate technical decisions clearly in review calls and project syncs without needing repeated prompting to explain reasoning.
* Good ability to think through solution architecture and system design, including component boundaries, data flow, API design, scalability trade\-offs, reliability, and maintainability.
* Strong written communication for async updates, PRs, and documentation


**Working Proficiency Requirements**
*Candidates do not need to be experts in these areas, but they should have enough working knowledge to understand, discuss, and contribute.*
* Docker: containerizing Python services, multi\-stage builds, docker\-compose for local stacks
* Deep RAG expertise: Graph RAG, hybrid retrieval, vector database internals (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector)
* Custom LLM agent design: memory management, multi\-step reasoning, tool routing, state machines
* Agent observability: tracing, logging agent runs, dashboards (LangSmith, Phoenix, custom)
* LLM/VLM fine\-tuning: PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA), GRPO, instruction tuning pipelines
* Fine\-tuning object detection models for practical use cases, including dataset preparation, annotation quality checks, training configuration, and performance evaluation.
* Good working ability with vision agents, including visual reasoning workflows, image/document inputs, OCR/VLM handoffs, and tool\-based orchestration.
* Good understanding of audio handling in agent workflows, including transcription, audio preprocessing basics, speech\-to\-text integration, and routing audio\-derived outputs into downstream tools.
* Good ability to handle multi\-extension documents across formats such as PDFs, images, spreadsheets, presentations, text files, and structured exports in AI pipelines.
* Good understanding of converting structured data to unstructured representations and extracting structured outputs from unstructured inputs.
* Awareness of database selection based on use case, including when to use MongoDB, Neo4j, SQL databases, vector databases, or hybrid storage patterns.
* Frontend / UI basics: HTML/CSS/JS or Streamlit for internal tooling and demos
* Ability to actively contribute to product and solution architecture discussions by proposing practical design options and understanding trade\-offs.
* Awareness of the latest releases, frameworks, and modern technologies, with the ability to choose current, practical solutions instead of relying on outdated approaches.

title: Testing Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 J.P. Morgan Commercial Investment Bank is a global leader in investment and wealth management, serving institutions, high\-net\-worth individuals, and retail investors worldwide.
   

  

 As an Associate\-level User Acceptance Tester within Global Payments Regulatory Reporting, you validate the impact of business and technology change on global regulatory reporting solutions. You partner with Product, Operations, and Technology to ensure deliverables meet functional requirements, control expectations, and production\-readiness standards through disciplined test planning, execution, and defect management. You improve quality and speed with automation\-first testing, strong traceability, and data\-led validation across end\-to\-end flows.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Plan and execute UAT for initiatives impacting regulatory reporting, aligning outcomes to documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Translate business requirements into test scenarios and cases, maintaining traceability and executing functional, end\-to\-end, regression, and negative testing.
* Develop and maintain automated test suites to improve coverage, repeatability, and cycle time, integrating automation into the UAT lifecycle with technology partners.
* Manage defects end\-to\-end by producing high\-quality evidence, triaging with technology and analysts, validating fixes, and confirming closure against expected results.
* Coordinate test readiness across stakeholders, including environments, test data creation, schedules, and go/no\-go inputs.
* Produce audit\-ready test artefacts (plans, scripts, evidence packs, execution reporting) and ensure documentation supports control expectations.
* Escalate risks promptly when scope, quality, dependencies, or timelines are at risk, applying strong ownership and delivery discipline.


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Knowledge of global regulatory reporting expectations, including completeness, accuracy, timeliness, data lineage, reconciliations, and controlled change management
* Strong analytical and communication skills to interpret requirements, write clear test cases, validate outcomes using data/evidence, and manage competing priorities.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Experience testing payments products across geographies, currencies, and schemes in high\-volume or time\-critical environments

**Job Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 2–3 months initially  
**Work Mode:** Office / Hybrid / Field and Online Research  
**Preferred Qualification:** MBA student or MBA fresher, preferably in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, or related specialization

Job Summary

We are looking for a curious, energetic, and growth\-oriented **Business Development Intern** to support lead generation, market research, prospect qualification, and demo scheduling for a workforce technology platform.

This internship is suitable for an MBA fresher or MBA student who wants practical exposure to B2B sales, business development, client communication, and consultative selling.

The intern will help identify potential organizations, find relevant decision\-makers, conduct first\-level outreach, understand basic business needs, and schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.

The intern will not be responsible for closing deals or conducting full product demos. The senior team will handle detailed product discussions, demos, pricing, and final conversions.

Key Responsibilities

* Research and identify potential organizations across industries such as manufacturing, education, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, and other growing businesses.
* Build and maintain a structured lead database with company details, industry, location, decision\-maker information, contact details, and outreach status.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers such as founders, owners, HR managers, operations heads, administrators, and business heads.
* Conduct first\-level outreach through phone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp where appropriate.
* Briefly introduce the product and understand whether the organization has relevant workforce\-management needs.
* Ask basic discovery questions related to attendance, leave management, employee communication, hiring, training, task visibility, and employee engagement.
* Qualify prospects based on relevance, interest level, business need, and willingness to explore a discussion.
* Schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospects and update lead status accurately.
* Share daily or weekly reports on leads researched, conversations held, qualified prospects, demos scheduled, and next steps.

Required Skills

* Good communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Confidence to speak with business owners, HR professionals, administrators, and operations leaders.
* Basic understanding of internet research, LinkedIn, email communication, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Ability to listen carefully, ask relevant questions, and document responses clearly.
* Good follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Curiosity to understand business problems and customer needs.
* Willingness to learn about workforce technology, HR tech, and B2B sales.

Mindset We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone curious, sincere, and hungry to learn.

This opportunity is best suited for a person who wants to understand business from the ground up through real market research, customer conversations, follow\-ups, and practical exposure.

The ideal candidate should have:

* Hunger to learn and grow professionally.
* Willingness to start from the basics and build strong fundamentals.
* Curiosity to understand how businesses work.
* Persistence to follow up with discipline.
* Ownership to complete tasks properly.
* Openness to feedback and improvement.
* Interest in building a long\-term career in sales, business development, consulting, or client\-facing roles.

This is not a routine telecalling internship. It is a learning opportunity for someone who wants to build real\-world business development skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* MBA student or MBA fresher.
* Specialization in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, or a related field preferred.
* Comfortable with calls, online research, LinkedIn outreach, and professional communication.
* Interested in B2B sales, lead generation, client interaction, and consultative selling.
* Organized in maintaining data, reports, and follow\-ups.
* Able to identify genuine opportunities rather than simply collecting contact details.

What You Will Learn

* How to identify potential B2B opportunities.
* How to research and profile organizations.
* How to find and approach decision\-makers.
* How to conduct first\-level discovery conversations.
* How to qualify leads before a product demo.
* How to maintain a structured sales pipeline.
* How consultative selling differs from regular telecalling.
* How workforce technology and HR tech platforms are positioned to businesses.

Performance Expectations

The intern will be expected to:

* Build a clean and relevant prospect database.
* Identify suitable decision\-makers.
* Conduct professional first\-level outreach.
* Generate meaningful conversations.
* Schedule qualified product demos or introductory meetings.
* Maintain accurate records and follow\-up notes.

Stipend and Incentives

A fixed internship stipend may be provided, along with performance\-based incentives for qualified demos or meetings scheduled.

Compensation will depend on the candidate’s commitment, communication ability, quality of work, and ability to generate qualified business opportunities.

Growth Opportunity

This internship may lead to a longer\-term role based on performance, maturity, ownership, communication skills, and ability to generate qualified opportunities.

High\-performing interns may be considered for future roles such as:

* Business Development Associate
* Lead Generation Associate
* Inside Sales Associate
* Client Relationship Executive
* Product Sales Consultant

description:
**Job Title: Immigration Sales Manager – Team Handling \& Target Achievement**

**Company:** Rajveer Chahal Education Consultant  
**Location:** Mohali, Punjab  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Permanent \| On\-Site  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month \+ Performance Incentives

About the Company

Rajveer Chahal Education Consultant is a growing immigration and overseas education consultancy providing professional guidance for study visa, visitor visa, spouse open work permit, dependent visa, admissions, refusal cases, and other immigration\-related services.

We are hiring an experienced and target\-driven **Immigration Sales Manager** who can lead the sales and counseling team, manage daily targets, improve conversions, and help the company achieve monthly revenue goals.

This role is suitable for a candidate who has strong practical experience in the immigration industry and understands different immigration products such as **study visa, visitor visa, spouse open work permit, dependent cases, refusal cases, and admission\-related services**.

Important Note Before Applying

This is not a fresher role and not a simple counselor role.

Apply only if you have:

* Experience in immigration sales
* Experience in handling a sales or counseling team
* Experience in achieving monthly targets
* Knowledge of study visa, visitor visa, spouse open work permit, dependent visa, and refusal cases
* Ability to train counselors and improve their closing performance
* Ability to manage leads, follow\-ups, reporting, and team accountability

Candidates without immigration sales and team\-handling experience should not apply.

Job Role Overview

The Immigration Sales Manager will be responsible for managing the complete sales team and ensuring that monthly targets are achieved.

The main responsibility of this role is to **handle the team, push daily performance, improve conversions, close high\-value cases, train counselors, and make sure all immigration products are sold properly and ethically**.

The candidate should be able to manage sales for multiple services, including:

* Study visa
* Visitor visa
* Spouse open work permit
* Dependent visa
* Refusal cases
* Admissions
* Other immigration\-related services

Key ResponsibilitiesSales Target

* Achieve monthly sales, a team performance
* Create daily, weekly, and monthly sales plans for the team
* Track counselor\-wise performance and conversion ratios
* Monitor lead conversion from inquiry to registration and final file processing
* Push the team to achieve daily calling, follow\-up, walk\-in, and closing targets
* Personally handle important, high\-value, or complicated cases
* Identify weak areas in the sales process and improve them
* Build a target\-driven culture within the team

Team Handling \& Leadership

* Lead and manage counselors, and sales staff
* Allocate leads properly according to counselor experience and product category
* Conduct daily team meetings for target review, pending leads, hot leads, and closures
* Train the team on counseling, product knowledge, objection handling, and closing
* Monitor call quality, WhatsApp follow\-ups, walk\-ins, and registrations
* Hold the team accountable for daily performance
* Identify weak performers and improve them through training and monitoring
* Maintain discipline, professionalism, and proper reporting in the sales team

Immigration Product Sales \& Counseling

* Guide students and clients for suitable immigration services according to their profile
* Counsel clients for study visa, visitor visa, spouse open work permit, dependent visa, refusal cases, and admissions
* Explain process, documentation, eligibility, timelines, fees, and possible outcomes clearly
* Handle objections related to budget, refusal risk, gap, academics, funds, travel history, family ties, and visa chances
* Convert serious inquiries into paid registrations
* Ensure that the team gives honest, professional, and practical counseling
* Make sure clients understand the complete process before registration

Lead Management \& Follow\-Up System

* Ensure all leads are properly updated in CRM or Excel
* Monitor hot, warm, cold, pending, and lost leads
* Make sure no lead is missed by the team
* Track daily calls, WhatsApp messages, follow\-ups, walk\-ins, and closures
* Build strong follow\-up systems for different services
* Ensure proper follow\-up for old leads, fresh leads, social media leads, walk\-ins, and referral leads
* Prepare daily and weekly lead performance reports for management

Coordination With Filing \& Admissions Team

* Coordinate with admission, documentation, and visa filing teams
* Ensure smooth handover of registered clients to the processing team
* Track pending documents, offer letters, file preparation, and submission updates
* Reduce communication gaps between sales, admission, and filing departments
* Ensure proper client communication throughout the process
* Support the team in solving client concerns before and after registration

Mandatory Experience Required

* Minimum 3 years of experience in immigration sales or overseas education sales
* Minimum 1 year of experience in handling a sales/counseling team
* Practical knowledge of study visa, visitor visa, spouse open work permit, dependent visa, and refusal cases
* Proven experience in achieving monthly sales or revenue targets
* Experience in converting leads into paid clients
* Strong knowledge of lead management and follow\-up systems
* Experience in counseling students, parents, spouses, and visitor visa clients

Required Skills

* Strong team handling and leadership skills
* Strong sales closing ability
* Good knowledge of immigration products
* Excellent communication and convincing skills
* Strong objection\-handling ability
* Ability to work under pressure and achieve targets
* Good knowledge of CRM, Excel, reports, and daily tracking
* Disciplined, target\-oriented, and result\-focused mindset
* Ability to train and improve counselors
* Good understanding of client psychology and sales follow\-up

Preferred Candidate Profile

Preference will be given to candidates who:

* Have worked as Immigration Sales Manager, Branch Manager, Team Leader, Senior Counselor, or Sales Head
* Have managed a team of at least 5\-8 people
* Have handled multiple immigration products,
* Have strong experience in visitor visa, spouse open work permit, study visa, and refusal cases
* Can independently manage targets, team meetings, reporting, and closing
* Understand Punjab immigration market and client behavior
* Can join immediately or within a short notice period

Key Performance Indicators

The candidate’s performance will be measured on:

* Monthly revenue target achievement
* Team target achievement
* Product\-wise sales performance
* Lead conversion ratio
* Counselor\-wise performance
* Follow\-up completion
* Walk\-in to registration conversion
* Quality of counseling
* CRM/reporting accuracy
* Coordination with filing and admission teams

Salary \& Benefits

* Fixed salary: ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month
* Attractive performance\-based incentives
* Long\-term growth opportunity
* Leadership role in a growing immigration company
* Professional and target\-driven work environment
* Opportunity to manage and grow a complete immigration sales team

Work Location

Mohali, Punjab  
This is a full\-time, on\-site role. Remote or work\-from\-home candidates will not be considered.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume.

Only candidates with immigration sales, team handling, target achievement, and knowledge of multiple immigration products should apply.

* Are you comfortable with target pressure?
* Which immigration products have you handled?

title: Quality Control Trainee
description:
**Quality Control (QC) Trainee** 

**Company Overview:**

**Pratiroop Mudran** is a leading name in the printing and packaging industry. We pride ourselves on delivering high\-quality, precision\-driven packaging solutions to our clients. To maintain our strict standards of excellence, we are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated **QC Trainee** to join our growing quality assurance team.

**Position Summary**

As a QC Trainee, you will be trained to monitor, test, and inspect our printing and packaging processes. You will ensure that all raw materials, in\-process production, and finished goods meet our company's high\-quality standards and client specifications.

* **Role:** QC Trainee
* **Industry:** Printing \& Packaging
* **Experience:** Freshers are welcome / 0 to 1 Year of experience in a QC department
* **Education:** B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Chemistry/) OR Diploma in Printing Technology / Packaging
* **Salary:** ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 per month (Negotiable based on interview performance)

**Key Responsibilities**

* **In\-Process Inspection:** Conduct regular quality checks during the printing, cutting, and packaging stages to identify defects early.
* **Raw Material Verification:** Inspect incoming raw materials (paper, paperboard, inks, adhesives) against standard specifications.
* **Final Product Testing:** Ensure the final packed products meet standard dimensions, color matching, and structural integrity.
* **Defect Reporting:** Identify deviations, log defects, and report them immediately to the senior QC Executive or Production Manager.
* **Documentation:** Maintain neat and accurate daily quality inspection reports and logs.
* **Lab Testing:** Assist in basic laboratory testing (e.g., GSM checking, moisture testing, GSM/bursting strength, shade matching).

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Basic Technical Knowledge:** Familiarity with printing processes and packaging materials is a huge plus.
* **Eye for Detail:** Strong visual inspection skills to spot color variations, misregistrations, or printing flaws.
* **Color Perception:** Excellent color vision (ability to pass standard color\-blindness tests is essential for shade matching).
* **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to take accurate measurements using tools like micrometers, vernier calipers, and GSM scales.
* **Communication:** Good verbal and written communication skills for internal reporting.
* **Tech Savvy:** Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel and Word) for data entry.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on training from industry experts in printing and packaging quality standards.
* A supportive and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Clear career progression from Trainee to QC Executive.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

**SALES OFFICER — JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Sales Officer — Gold Finance**

**Reports To:** Branch Manager / Assistant Branch Manager

**Supervises:** N/A — Individual Contributor

**Location:** Branch\-based with active field duty — local market coverage, doorstep visits, and lead follow\-up in the branch catchment area

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Officer is the frontline growth engine of the KGF branch — responsible for generating new gold loan customers, converting leads, driving disbursement volumes, and deepening relationships with existing customers for renewals and top\-ups. The SO operates both at the counter and in the field — visiting markets, households, and business establishments to create awareness and acquire customers. The role demands a proactive, self\-driven personality with strong local market knowledge, persuasion skills, and a genuine ability to build lasting customer trust on behalf of the KGF brand.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Lead Generation \& New Customer Acquisition**

* Generate new gold loan leads through field visits — markets, residential areas, commercial hubs — within the branch catchment.
* Conduct door\-to\-door campaigns and community events to build brand awareness and attract first\-time gold loan customers.
* Identify and target key customer segments — micro\-entrepreneurs, traders, farmers, homemakers, and self\-employed individuals.
* Build and maintain a personal lead pipeline — minimum lead targets to be met weekly as set by BM.
* Follow up on all assigned leads from the telecalling team within 24 hours — no lead left uncontacted beyond one business day.
* Collect customer references from every satisfied borrower and convert referrals into active loan accounts.
* Track lead\-to\-disbursement conversion rate; identify drop\-off points and report to BM with corrective action plan.

**B. Disbursement Target Achievement**

* Own individual monthly disbursement target — plan weekly activity to ensure on\-track achievement at all times.
* Coordinate with counter staff and ABM to ensure customer brought to branch is processed and disbursed same day.
* Drive renewal disbursements — proactively contact customers whose loans are due for renewal before the loan expiry date.
* Promote top\-up loans to customers with good repayment history — identify eligible accounts from ABM\-shared list.
* Submit daily disbursement activity report to BM — leads met, customers visited, disbursements achieved, pipeline for tomorrow.
* Participate in morning briefing with full knowledge of the day's target and plan of action.

**C. Field Activity \& Market Coverage**

* Execute daily field beat plan — minimum number of customer visits and prospect contacts as set by BM.
* Cover assigned micro\-market zones systematically — no repeated coverage of same area while leaving other zones unvisited.
* Attend local events, mandis, weekly markets, and business associations to represent KGF and generate walk\-in traffic.
* Identify new business hubs, growth corridors, and underserved pockets within the catchment; report to BM for territory planning.
* Distribute KGF marketing material — brochures, rate cards, scheme flyers — during field visits and community outreach.
* Maintain a field visit log — customer name, location, purpose, outcome, and follow\-up date — submitted daily to BM.

**D. Customer Relationship Management**

* Build strong, trust\-based relationships with existing customers — visit personally at loan renewal and overdue milestones.
* Educate customers on KGF gold loan products, interest rates, schemes, and repayment options — accurate information only.
* Handle customer queries and concerns in the field; escalate unresolved issues to BM without delay.
* Maintain customer contact details updated in the system — phone number, address, and alternate contact verified at every interaction.
* Support ABM in collecting overdue amounts from field customers — soft follow\-up visits and negotiated repayment commitments.
* Ensure every customer leaves with a positive KGF experience — conduct, language, and professionalism at all times.

**E. Collections Support**

* Assist ABM in overdue recovery — visit 30\-day and 60\-day bucket customers in the field for soft collection follow\-up.
* Communicate repayment reminders to customers approaching due dates — calls and field visits as directed by ABM.
* Collect overdue amounts from field customers where authorised by BM; deposit collected cash to branch cashier same day without exception.
* Never retain any collected cash overnight — any deviation treated as a serious compliance breach.
* Report field customer feedback on repayment difficulty or gold valuation concerns to ABM for resolution.

**F. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Assist customers in completing KYC documentation at the field stage — check completeness before bringing to branch.
* Never promise interest rates, LTV ratios, or loan amounts not sanctioned by KGF credit policy — refer to published scheme cards.
* Comply with KGF code of conduct during all field visits — no soliciting of gifts, commissions, or personal favours from customers.
* Report any competitor activity, fraudulent gold pledging attempts, or suspicious customer behaviour to BM immediately.
* Maintain accurate and honest reporting of field activity — fabricated visit logs treated as gross misconduct.

**G. Reporting \& MIS**

* Submit end\-of\-day field activity report to BM — visits completed, leads generated, disbursements supported, next\-day plan.
* Maintain personal lead tracker — source, contact details, loan requirement, status, and follow\-up schedule.
* Attend weekly performance review with BM — present lead pipeline, conversion status, and reasons for gaps.
* Contribute to branch monthly business plan — provide bottom\-up lead and disbursement forecast for SO territory.

**ELIGIBILITY \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate in any discipline — B.Com / BBA preferred; HSC with strong field experience also considered.
* 1–4 years of field sales experience in NBFC, gold loan, microfinance, insurance, or banking sector.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, local market knowledge, and self\-motivation considered for trainee roles.
* Working knowledge of gold loan products, interest calculation, and KYC norms preferred.
* Strong Tamil communication — ability to converse confidently with diverse customer profiles in the local market.
* Two\-wheeler licence and own vehicle mandatory — daily field coverage across branch catchment required.
* Mobile proficiency — lead tracking app, WhatsApp business communication, and basic MIS reporting.

**KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Field sales and prospecting **Customer acquisition and lead conversion**
* Local market and community knowledge **Persuasion and objection handling**
* Gold loan product knowledge **Relationship building and retention**
* Time management and beat planning **Reporting discipline and data accuracy**

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* **Monthly disbursement target —** % of individual target achieved — primary performance metric.
* **New customer acquisition —** number of first\-time borrowers onboarded per month.
* **Lead conversion rate —** % of generated leads converted to disbursed loans.
* **Renewal conversion —** % of due\-for\-renewal accounts converted before loan expiry.
* **Referral generation —** number of active referrals collected and converted per month.
* **Field visit compliance —** daily beat plan completion — visits logged vs target.
* **Collections support —** % of assigned overdue accounts contacted and followed up in the month.
* **Documentation accuracy —** % of customer files brought to branch with complete KYC — zero rejection rate at counter.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

* Salary: As per company norms — commensurate with experience and market.
* Performance incentive: Monthly payout linked to disbursement achievement and new customer acquisition — uncapped for top performers.
* Field allowance: Travel reimbursement as per KGF field staff policy.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Sanatan Wisdom is an Indian non\-governmental organization and research\-driven spiritual initiative co\-founded by philosopher Devrishi and Vedic scholar Sadhana Pandey. The organization is dedicated to the global revival of Sanatan Sanskriti through a synthesis of India’s ancient Vedic knowledge systems and sonic healing sciences with modern scientific inquiry. Its work focuses on mantra science, Indian sonic philosophy, consciousness studies, and the preservation of classical Indic traditions. Sanatan Wisdom aims to reinterpret Bharat’s timeless spiritual heritage as a living, practical force for contemporary life and global communities. Team members collaborate in an intellectually rigorous, spiritually grounded environment that values both scholarship and applied practice.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Assistant Writer \& Manuscript Developer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bhopal. The role involves supporting the development of books, research monographs, and teaching materials grounded in Vedic philosophy, mantra science, and consciousness studies. Day\-to\-day tasks include drafting chapters and essays, refining conceptual outlines, structuring manuscripts, and assisting in translating complex Indic philosophical ideas into clear, accessible English. The role also requires literature review, source verification from classical texts and contemporary research, and close collaboration with senior scholars to incorporate feedback and maintain doctrinal accuracy. The Assistant Writer will help prepare content for publication, including formatting, citation management, copyediting, and coordinating with designers or publishers as needed, while maintaining confidentiality and scholarly integrity.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English, with the ability to present complex spiritual and philosophical concepts clearly and coherently.
* Background or demonstrable interest in Vedic studies, Indian philosophy, Sanskrit texts, or comparative religion; familiarity with mantra science and Indic spiritual traditions is an advantage.
* Research skills, including literature review, source evaluation, and basic citation practices for both classical and modern academic materials.
* Ability to work closely with senior scholars, incorporate detailed feedback, and manage multiple manuscript sections or projects in parallel.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Humanities, Philosophy, Religious Studies, Sanskrit, Indology, or related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines in a focused, on\-site research and writing environment in Bhopal.
* Respectful and inclusive attitude, openness to diverse spiritual perspectives, and commitment to non\-discriminatory, gender\-neutral language in all written work.

**Manager – Corporate HR Business Partnering \& Talent Acquisition** 




  





**Job Purpose** 




  





 We are seeking a strategic and business\-focused HR professional to partner with corporate functions, lead end\-to\-end talent acquisition, and drive early careers programs. This role plays a critical part in shaping the organization’s talent strategy, strengthening employee experience, and enabling a high\-performance and future\-ready workforce through innovative and data\-driven people practices.

**HR Business Partnering** 



* Partner with business leaders to align people strategy with business objectives and organizational priorities.
* Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, ensuring a seamless and engaging employee experience from onboarding through exit.
* Drive initiatives to enhance onboarding experience and accelerate new hire integration and productivity.
* Analyze employee engagement and pulse survey results, develop actionable plans with business leaders, and ensure execution to improve engagement and organizational health.
* Drive attrition analysis and implement retention strategies through data\-driven interventions and proactive engagement initiatives.
* Lead key talent processes including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, employee engagement, and organizational effectiveness.
* Collaborate closely with HR Centres of Excellence (Talent Management, Learning \& Development, Rewards, HR Operations, etc.) on enterprise\-wide people initiatives.
* Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organization design, change management, and capability building.
* Drive strategic initiatives including career pathing, internal mobility, leadership development, and capability building.
* Leverage people analytics, benchmarks, and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Champion innovation by streamlining HR processes and driving digital, AI\-enabled, and future\-ready HR solutions.



  





**Talent Acquisition** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle from requisition to offer release for all corporate functions across grades.
* Demonstrate expertise in senior leadership hiring, partnering with business leaders to attract high\-calibre leadership talent.
* Develop and execute hiring strategies to attract high\-quality talent while optimizing Quality of Hire, Time to Hire, Cost per Hire, Offer\-to\-Join Ratio, and Candidate Dropout Rate.
* Manage Talent Acquisition AOP budget, ensuring effective cost planning, vendor optimization, and optimal utilization of recruitment spend.
* Drive hiring through multiple sourcing channels with strong focus on job portals (LinkedIn, Naukri, and other digital platforms), along with employee referrals, social recruiting, recruitment partners, and talent communities.
* Ensure strong stakeholder management with business leaders and HR partners to align hiring priorities, role expectations, and closure timelines.
* Build robust talent pipelines through proactive market mapping and talent intelligence.
* Drive Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (DE\&I) hiring initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
* Deliver an exceptional hiring manager and candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Leverage recruitment analytics, sourcing metrics, and market intelligence to continuously improve hiring effectiveness and process efficiency.



  





**Campus Hiring \& Early Careers** 



* Lead the organization’s campus hiring strategy across premier institutes and universities.
* Manage end\-to\-end hiring for Management Trainees (MTs), CA Industrial Trainees, and Technology Trainees.
* Design and manage the one\-year Management Trainee journey, including onboarding, structured learning interventions, rotations, mentoring, performance management, engagement, and career development.
* Conceptualize and implement innovative campus engagement programs and early careers initiatives to strengthen employer branding and position the organization as an Employer of Choice.
* Build strong partnerships with educational institutions, placement teams, faculty, and student communities to create sustainable talent pipelines.
* Drive campus outreach and branding initiatives to attract high\-quality early\-career talent.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* Proven experience in HR Business Partnering and Talent Acquisition, including campus hiring.
* Strong expertise in senior leadership hiring and stakeholder management.
* Experience in managing early careers programs and graduate hiring cycles.
* Strong understanding of employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational development.
* Data\-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and project management capabilities.
* Proven ability to drive innovation, process excellence, and continuous improvement in HR practices.

 Primary Skills

description:
We are hiring QA Engineers who can do both manual testing and test automation. You will own quality end\-to\-end for the features, design and execute test cases, do exploratory and regression testing, and then automate the high\-value flows in Playwright with TypeScript so they are protected forever. This is not a "manual now, automation later" role; both happen in the same sprint, by the same person.
   

  

**The Core Responsibilities For The Job Include The Following**
**Manual Testing and Quality Ownership:**
* Own quality for features from requirements review through release sign\-off.
* Design, document, and execute test cases covering functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing across our web app, responsive mobile web, and Chrome extension.
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and stand\-ups; review user stories and surface ambiguities before development starts.
* Reproduce, isolate, and document defects with clear repro steps, expected vs. actual behavior, logs, and screenshots / recordings.
* Maintain test case repositories in Confluence; keep documentation current as features evolve.


**Test Automation**
* Design, build, and maintain UI and API automation in Playwright with TypeScript using Page Object Model, fixtures, and data\-driven patterns.
* Write automation alongside the feature, not after release. Automate critical paths within the same sprint as the manual test pass.
* Build and maintain API test coverage using Playwright's request fixture; supplement with Postman for exploratory and contract checks where appropriate.
* Tag, organize, and parallelize tests so the suite stays fast.
* Investigate and fix flaky tests with the same rigor as production bugs; flakiness erodes trust in the suite.
* Maintain CI/CD integration via Bitbucket Pipelines: PR validation, nightly cross\-browser regression, post\-deploy production smoke, and scheduled health checks.


**Collaboration And Process**
* Log, track, and report defects in Jira; collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile / Scrum environment with weekly releases.
* Partner with frontend engineers contributing their first Playwright tests: review their PRs and help establish conventions (data\-testid usage, locator priorities, and naming).
* Contribute to the weekly "escaped bug" review when a production bug slips through, help analyze why, and convert it into a permanent regression test.
* Report on quality metrics: open defects, severity distribution, regression coverage, automation suite runtime, and flake rate.


**Requirements**
* Our stack is intentionally TypeScript end\-to\-end so QA and engineering share one language. Frontend engineers also contribute Playwright tests, so you will collaborate closely with developers and help shape conventions, frameworks, and CI pipelines.
* Experience: 2 to 5 years in software quality assurance, with hands\-on exposure to both manual testing and UI automation.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on QA experience on web applications (SaaS / B2B preferred), with real exposure to BOTH manual testing and UI automation.
* Strong manual test design skills: equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, decision tables, and exploratory charters; the ability to write test cases that another QA could pick up and execute.
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright (preferred) or a similar modern framework. Solid TypeScript / JavaScript fundamentals: async / await, promises, modules, basic typing, and the ES standard library.
* Working knowledge of test framework concepts: Page Object Model, fixtures, data\-driven testing, parallel execution.
* Proficient at writing reliable selectors, prefers semantic locators (getByRole, getByLabel, getByTestId) but comfortable with XPath and handling dynamic elements when needed.
* Hands\-on API testing experience: REST, JSON, auth flows. Comfortable with Postman and/or Playwright's request fixture.
* Solid grasp of HTTP, browser developer tools (network tab, console, and application storage), and cross\-browser / responsive testing.
* Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD pipeline (Bitbucket Pipelines preferred; Jenkins / GitHub Actions experience translates).
* Comfortable with Git workflows: feature branches, pull requests, code reviews.
* Experience with Jira for defect tracking and Confluence for documentation.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills can isolate whether a failure is product, test, environmental, or data and act on it independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication your bug reports and test plans should be unmistakable.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience testing Chrome extensions or other browser\-integrated products.
* Exposure to performance / load testing tools k6 JMeter, Gatling, or Artillery.

description:
**DevOps Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a DevOps engineer to build and operate cloud\-native foundations and to partner closely with AI and application engineers. This is a hands\-on role spanning DevOps fundamentals — Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, and infrastructure\-as\-code — and AI/ML infrastructure such as GPU\-backed model serving and the data services that AI applications depend on.
   

  

 You will help stand up pragmatic, right\-sized platform foundations and act as the infrastructure partner to application engineers — deploying and scaling their services reliably, keeping the developer loop fast, and building security and observability in from the start. We are looking for a candidate with a strong academic record and solid computer\-science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving) alongside hands\-on platform experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**DevOps Foundations**
* Bootstrap and operate Kubernetes (AKS) plus the surrounding cloud\-native foundations: container registry, secrets management, identity, and monitoring.
* Own the build\-and\-deploy path end to end — containerisation (Docker/BuildKit), image registry, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines), and GitOps (Argo CD or Flux).
* Codify infrastructure with Terraform and/or Bicep and Helm so environments are reproducible and reviewable.


**AI Infrastructure \& Data Plane**
* Package and deploy application and AI/agent services, including the runtime, secrets, and configuration they require.
* Provision and operate the data plane: managed PostgreSQL, Redis, a vector store, a graph store, object storage, and a queue / event bus.
* Stand up self\-hosted inference — e.g. vLLM on a GPU node pool — alongside hosted\-model connectors; use KEDA/HPA to scale stateless pods (down to zero) and bin\-pack GPU efficiently.


**Isolation, Security \& Reliability**
* Implement tenant/workload isolation: namespaces, deny\-by\-default NetworkPolicy, ResourceQuota/LimitRange, and scoped secrets.
* Manage secrets and identity with a secrets manager / KMS and an identity provider; keep credentials out of code.
* Establish observability and basic SRE practice: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus \+ Grafana (or cloud\-native monitoring), tracing, alerting, and runbooks.


**Collaboration \& Cost**
* Pair with application engineers on inference, persistence, and durable\-execution concerns.
* Keep the platform cost\-aware — right\-size nodes, scale to zero, and surface spend.
* Contribute to engineering standards and a fast, low\-friction developer loop.

 Data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, strong problem\-solving

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 Customer \& Product Support (C\&PS) sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and R\&D teams. Through close teamwork and collaboration, we drive positive customer outcomes and ensure seamless access and optimal utilization of AlphaSense’s market\-leading platform and products. We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer \& Product Support team is based globally across the US, Canada, UK, India and Singapore.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive Cloud Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will own technical problems end\-to\-end within your scope including investigating, diagnosing and resolving customer issues across SaaS and private cloud environments. In your role day\-to\-day, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical customer contacts on more complex cases.
   

  

 You will be the second line of defense for technical queries, working at the intersection of customers, frontline support and Engineering. This is a strong foundation role for someone early in their cloud support career with some experience, who has demonstrated relevant technical skills, contributing to a high\-trust team and the ability to apply AI tools to scale their impact.
   

  

 Growth paths from this role include progression with the Support function to Senior Cloud Support Engineer and beyond, or a move into our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, supported by structured training and collaboration with Engineering.
   

  

 Who You Are
   

  

* A technically curious engineer with 2 \- 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
* A clear communicator in writing and on customer calls, with the ability to explain technical concepts with appropriate clarity.
* A problem\-solver with a proactive, customer\-first mindset and an eye for surfacing risks early.
* Adaptable, eager to continuously learn, and willing to ask for help when blocked.
* Energized by being part of an entrepreneurial team and willing to pull your own weight to help the team succeed.


 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Deliver exceptional technical support: Act as the second line of defense for technical queries, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer issues through close collaboration between L1 support and R\&D teams. Own the customer\-facing loop on your assigned tickets, driving them to resolution with urgency.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges: Diagnose issues using logs, traces, and reproducible test cases; work confidently with kubectl, awscli, and at least one scripting language. Resolve in\-scope issues completely and escalate out\-of\-scope issues to the correct engineering domain with high\-quality artifacts.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Partner effectively within the team and across regions and time zones; share knowledge proactively and close loops on commitments. Build working relationships with both account teams and R\&D as you grow your technical credibility.
* Documentation: Contribute to runbooks, KEDB articles, and FAQs. Maintain documentation hygiene on the issues you own.
* Be an advocate for customers: Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions and initiatives to maximize the value of our platform and products.
* Build working knowledge of the AlphaSense platform and core products. Identify your own knowledge gaps and build a plan to close them.
* Use AI tools in your daily work for technical investigations, log analysis, customer communication and documentation. Build repeatable prompts and workflows rather than one\-off use; share what works with the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2 \- 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
* Working proficiency with CLI tools (e.g., kubectl, awscli) and scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar.
* Working knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP\-related troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with connecting LLMs to external tools, including multi\-agent systems.
* Exposure to alerting and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, FireHydrant).
* Demonstrated AI fluency in day\-to\-day work: can speak to examples of how AI has changed the way they work.
* Experience managing customer support cases through their lifecycle from inquiry, triage, bug reporting, through to resolution.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and team members.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in networking and troubleshooting complex network issues
* Experience troubleshooting in at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and containerized environments using Kubernetes or Docker.
* Extensive experience working with GraphQL and other web APIs
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Crossplane, and related troubleshooting
* Experience with Search Technologies and Data Storages (e.g. Vespa, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, MySQL)
* Experience or familiarity with the Java programming language
* Experience with standard software release lifecycles.
