title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Sourcer — India
description:
Part\-Time Talent Sourcer / Recruiter — IndiaMarketing, Development \& AI Talent Screening

We are a New Zealand\-based business building and growing multiple ventures, including Viewings.co.nz, a property technology platform for the New Zealand market.

We are looking for a sharp, organised, and practical Talent Sourcer / Recruiter in India who can help us find, speak with, screen, and shortlist quality candidates and offshore partners.

This is a part\-time / freelance role to start, with the potential to grow if the results are strong.

Important: This Is Not a CV Forwarding Role

We are not looking for someone who simply collects resumes and forwards them to us.

Your job is to properly screen candidates before they reach us.

You must speak with candidates, understand their skills, assess their personality, check their communication, review their past work where possible, and only shortlist people who are genuinely worth our time.

The goal is quality, not quantity.

What You Will Help Us Find

You will help us source and shortlist people for roles such as:

* B2B marketing interns
* Junior digital marketing executives
* SEO and content marketing people
* Email marketing and LinkedIn outreach specialists
* Lead generation executives
* Full\-stack developers
* AI / automation talent
* CRM and business process automation people
* Offshore development companies
* Remote technical teams and freelancers
* Other business support roles as needed

Key Requirement

You must have a good practical understanding of marketing, development, and AI.

You do not need to be a senior marketer, developer, or AI engineer yourself, but you must understand these areas well enough to screen candidates properly, ask sensible questions, identify weak candidates, and shortlist people who can actually do the work.

You should be able to understand the difference between someone who talks well and someone who can actually deliver.

Main Responsibilities

* Source candidates from LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, communities, referrals, WhatsApp groups, and other channels
* Speak directly with candidates before recommending them
* Conduct initial screening calls
* Check communication skills, attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn
* Understand salary expectations and availability
* Confirm whether candidates can work with New Zealand time zones when required
* Review examples of past work, portfolios, GitHub, LinkedIn profiles, case studies, or campaign examples where relevant
* Ask basic role\-specific questions for marketing, development, AI, CRM, and automation roles
* Identify whether the candidate fits a fast\-moving startup environment
* Maintain a clean candidate tracker with notes and status
* Coordinate interviews with our team
* Follow up with candidates professionally
* Help compare freelancers, interns, full\-time staff, and offshore development companies

Screening Expectations

Before forwarding any candidate to us, you should provide:

* Candidate name and contact details
* Role they are suitable for
* Current location
* Experience summary
* Salary expectation
* Availability/notice period
* English communication level
* Strengths
* Weaknesses or concerns
* Past work reviewed, if any
* Your recommendation
* Why you believe this person is worth interviewing

Where suitable, we would also like you to use simple assessment methods such as:

* basic personality\-fit questions
* communication checks
* problem\-solving questions
* practical task\-based screening
* light psychometric\-style screening, if you are experienced with it

We do not need complicated testing. We need practical, intelligent filtering.

What We Are Looking For

You must be:

* Very diligent and organised
* Good at written and spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with candidates
* Good at using LinkedIn, Indeed, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, and AI tools
* Able to follow instructions properly
* Fast, practical, and reliable
* Comfortable working with a New Zealand\-based business
* Able to source both individuals and companies
* Able to judge attitude, communication, and execution ability
* Honest about candidate quality

Who This Role Suits

This role is suitable for someone who has experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, HR, staffing, or freelance hiring, especially for marketing, tech, startup, or remote roles.

You may be an independent recruiter, freelance recruiter, HR professional, or talent sourcer looking for part\-time work with an international business.

Expected Weekly Output

Each week, we expect clear progress, including:

* Candidates sourced
* Candidates spoken to
* Candidates rejected and why
* Candidates shortlisted and why
* Screening notes
* Salary expectations
* Availability
* Recommended next steps
* Offshore companies or freelancers reviewed, where relevant

How to Apply

Please apply with:

* Your recruitment or talent sourcing experience
* Types of roles you have hired or shortlisted for
* Your experience with marketing, development, AI, or remote hiring
* Your expected monthly or hourly rate
* How soon you can start
* Your availability each week
* A sample candidate tracker or shortlist format, if available

Please also answer this question:

If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property technology startup, what steps would you take in the first 7 days?

Pay: ₹9,348\.75 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Before sending a candidate to us, how would you check if they have the right skills, attitude, communication, salary expectations, availability, and startup fit? Please explain your screening process.
* Tell us about one candidate you rejected even though their CV looked good. Why did you reject them, and what did you learn from that?
* If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property\-tech startup, what exact steps would you take in the first 7 days?

title: Head Of Compensation & Benefits
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you.

 **Job Description**  

Version 1 is seeking a Head of Compensation \& Benefits to lead the design, implementation, and management of our global total reward strategy. As the business continues to scale across multiple regions, this role will ensure our compensation and benefits programmes are competitive, fair, and aligned with our growth objectives.


You will take ownership of pay structures, job evaluation frameworks, benefits provision, and reward programmes across all Version 1 locations. Working closely with senior leadership, Finance, and People teams, you will use market data and internal analytics to shape reward decisions that attract, retain, and motivate talent globally.


This is a strategic and hands\-on role, suited to someone who combines deep technical expertise in compensation and benefits with strong commercial awareness and the ability to operate across multiple jurisdictions.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of Version 1’s global compensation and benefits strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market competitiveness.
* Manage and develop the Compensation \& Benefits team, setting clear goals, reviewing outputs, and supporting professional growth.
* Design and maintain job evaluation and grading frameworks to ensure internal equity and consistency across all regions.
* Conduct regular market benchmarking and salary surveys to inform pay positioning and ensure competitiveness in key talent markets including India, UK, and Ireland.
* Own the annual pay review and bonus cycle end to end, partnering with Finance and senior leadership on budgeting, modelling, and communications.
* Design, implement, and manage employee benefits programmes across all operating regions, ensuring they meet local requirements and employee needs.
* Develop and maintain total reward statements and communications that help employees understand the full value of their package.
* Provide data\-driven insights and reporting on compensation and benefits spend, trends, and effectiveness to senior leadership.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant employment legislation, tax regulations, and reporting requirements relating to pay and benefits across all jurisdictions.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop competitive offer frameworks and support hiring decisions with market data.
* Support M\&A activity by conducting compensation and benefits due diligence and leading the harmonisation of reward programmes for acquired entities.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and tools, including increased use of technology and automation in reward administration.
* Manage relationships with external benefits providers, brokers, and consultants, ensuring value for money and quality of service.
* Contribute to broader People team strategy, bringing a reward and total compensation perspective to strategic discussions.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Compensation \& Benefits (e.g. GRP, CCP, CIPD) is desirable.
* 8\+ years of experience in compensation and benefits, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role.
* Proven track record of designing and managing compensation and benefits programmes across multiple countries.
* Strong knowledge of job evaluation methodologies (e.g. Willis Towers Watson, Mercer, Hay).
* Deep understanding of employment legislation, tax, and regulatory requirements relating to pay and benefits across India, UK, and Ireland.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in compensation modelling, benchmarking, and data analysis.
* Experience with HRIS and compensation management platforms (knowledge of Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar would be an advantage).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex reward data clearly to senior leadership.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance employee value with business affordability.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
